postings.title: 5G SA O-RAN Test Bed Co-Op (Engineering Co-Op)
postings.description:
5G SA O-RAN Test Bed Co-Op (Engineering Co-Op)

This is a full-time, in-person role at our Woburn, MA office. We are ideally seeking someone who can start in January 2027.

Are you interested in exploring the future of wireless communications and gaining hands-on experience with next generation 5G technologies? At STR, interns work alongside experienced engineers and software developers on meaningful projects that address challenging technical problems related to national security.

Our internship program gives you the opportunity to gain practical engineering experience, learn from experienced mentors, and develop skills in open-source software, Linux-based networking, and wireless communications. You’ll work in a collaborative engineering environment while contributing to the development and integration of emerging 5G technologies.

As part of the intelligence team, you’ll help establish and maintain a 5G Standalone (SA) Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) test bed using open-source software, including the Linux Foundation’s O-CU/DU and complementary components. You’ll gain hands-on experience configuring network and RAN components, integrating core-network systems, automating test-bed deployments, and troubleshooting interoperability challenges.

Responsibilities

- Assist the team in establishing and maintaining a 5G Standalone (SA) O-RAN test bed using open-source software.

- Install, configure, and maintain Linux-based networking and Radio Access Network (RAN) components.

- Collaborate with the software development team to integrate core-network and O-RAN components.

- Develop scripts and automation tools to support repeatable test-bed setup and configuration.

- Troubleshoot networking, integration, and interoperability issues across system components.

- Document system configurations, test procedures, troubleshooting processes, and experimental results.

- Participate in hands-on lab experimentation and learn about emerging 5G technologies and open-source wireless systems.

Requirements

- Currently pursuing a degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, telecommunications, or a related technical discipline.

- Basic understanding of networking concepts and protocols.

- Comfortable working in a Linux-based development environment.

- Some experience with Python or shell scripting.

- Interest in 5G wireless communications, Open Radio Access Networks (O-RAN), and open-source software.

- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.

- Ability to work collaboratively with software developers and engineering teams.

- U.S. citizenship is required due to the nature of STR’s work and clearance requirements. 

Perks:

- Competitive pay

- Flexible working hours

- Fun activities both in and outside the office

Pay Information
Hourly Range: $25.20-$54.00/hour

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

postings.title: Algorithm & Signal Processing Engineer
postings.description:
About the Team:

The Electronic Warfare and Novel Capabilities Group (EWNC) develops and delivers advanced signal processing algorithms and prototype systems for next-generation radar and electronic warfare technologies.

EWNC fosters a culture of innovation and collaboration. We investigate cutting edge technologies and interface with engineers across sectors and divisions at STR and researchers at academic institutions and industry partners to develop practical and effective solutions to RF sensing and counter-sensing challenges. If you're seeking an opportunity to apply your deep technical knowledge and creativity to make a lasting impact, we invite you to join us.

The Role:

As a Lead Algorithm & Signal Processing Researcher, you'll have the opportunity to develop state-of-the-art algorithms and techniques for sense making and sensor decision making, from signal detection and classification, to electronic support measures, attack, and protection, to cognitive EW and more.

What You Will Do:

- Design and apply cutting-edge signal processing and machine learning techniques to solve complex radar and RF sensing and counter-sensing challenges

- Design and implement models and simulations for advanced RF systems

- Lead small teams and projects

- Support business development and proposal writing efforts

- Collaborate with diverse teams to deploy cutting-edge capabilities to prototype systems

Who You Are:

- This position requires the ability to obtain a Top Secret security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is needed by U.S. Government

- BS with 2 years of experience or n Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or related technical discipline

- Experience in two or more of the following areas:

- RF/radar signal processing, optimization, waveform design, electronic warfare, machine learning, adaptive signal processing, AI/ML algorithm development, algorithm development, test & evaluation, model & simulation, or systems engineering, test engineering, radar modelling, or RF systems prototyping

- Proficiency in one or more scientific or mathematical programming languages, such as MATLAB, Python, and C/C++

- Strong mathematical, troubleshooting, written, and verbal communication skills

Even Better:

- Active Security Clearance

- Experience with RF technologies in the defense sector, particularly for sensing and electronic warfare applications including electronic attack, electronic protection, cognitive EW, and advanced electronic support measures techniques and algorithms

- Machine learning tasks such as natural language processing, image recognition, semantic segmentation, reinforcement learning, approaches such as Bayesian, deep convolutional and graph neural network methods, and tools such as PyTorch, Ray, TensorFlow/board, and MLflow

- Interacting with decision-makers and customers to translate mission needs into an end-to-end analytical solution

- Ability to apply novel, innovative and interdisciplinary approaches to challenging engineering problems

- Ability to create and present briefings to customers and senior management to provide both high-level and deep technical solution explanations 

Join EWNC and help shape the future of RF sensing and electronic warfare by developing innovative technologies that transition from advanced research into operational prototype systems. While this position is ideally suited for a Lead Engineer, applicants whose qualifications closely align with the requirements are encouraged to apply. We have opportunities for talented engineers at multiple experience levels in Woburn, MA. 

Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $110,000 - $140,000

postings.title: Associate Embedded Systems Emulation Engineer
postings.description:
STR is hiring an Associate Embedded Systems Emulation Engineer to join our multidisciplinary team of researchers and engineers developing cutting-edge technologies with significant and immediate impact on our national security. In this role, you will work at the intersection of computer systems and real-world physical systems, building the tools and models that emulate complex cyber-physical platforms to enable analysis, reverse engineering, and experimentation.

We believe every employee brings a unique set of skills, experiences, and perspectives that are essential to providing innovative solutions for our customers. You do not need to have experience with every technology listed to be successful in this role. Strong fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn new tools and domains are highly valued.

What you will do: 

- Work as part of a small, focused team to architect, develop, implement, and test modular software applications and tools for emulating cyber-physical systems.

- Extend and customize existing emulation frameworks (e.g., QEMU) in C/C++ and Python to support new targets, peripherals, and capabilities.

- Rehost unknown or sparsely documented firmware by analyzing binaries, identifying hardware dependencies, and adapting these to run correctly in emulated environments.

- Develop emulator tooling and virtual device models to support reverse engineering and analysis of embedded systems across diverse architectures (e.g., ARM, PPC).

- Develop digital models using virtualization tools (e.g., QEMU) and network them together to create integrated, end-to-end system simulations that closely approximate real hardware behavior.

- Ensure model quality and correctness through unit-level and system-level testing, and by validating behavior against first principles, measured data, documentation, and hardware/software artifacts.

- Communicate technical foundations of models and algorithms through reports and briefings

Who you are:

- This position requires an Active Secret security clearance with eligibility for Top Secret (TS) clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is needed by U.S. Government. 

- BS in Computer Engineering, Computers Science, Electrical Engineering or related field

- Strong foundation in C/C++ for systems-level or embedded software development

- Knowledge of Python for tool development, automation, and integration

- Familiarity with emulation and virtualization tools (e.g., QEMU or similar frameworks)

- Strong understanding of computer architecture, emulation principles, and software engineering best practices (e.g., modular design, testing, code review)

- Experience using collaborative source code management (e.g., Git)

Nice to have:

- Active Top Secret (TS) Security Clearance

- Familiarity with network architecture and protocols, and experience integrating networked simulations

- Experience with low-level software modifications (e.g., implants, firmware changes, binary patch development)

- Experience at the software/hardware interface, including device drivers or real-time/embedded operating systems

- Experience with reverse engineering and firmware rehosting for embedded systems, including analysis of instruction set architectures (e.g., ARM, PPC) and use of tools such as Ghidra, IDA Pro, or Binary Ninja

- Experience implementing component models (e.g., sensors, actuators, dynamics, environmental factors) in Python and/or C/C++, and integrate them into system-level simulations and software processing chains

- Experience working with hardware components and interfaces

- Masters or PhD in related field

Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $91,000 - $125,000

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

postings.title: Associate Signal Processing Engineer
postings.description:
About the Team:

The Sensors Division at STR focuses on technology development for advanced sensor systems and platforms in support of national security requirements. Our particular focus areas include airborne/spaceborne/surface-based radar, electronic warfare, underwater acoustics, hyperspectral imaging, and EO/IR sensing. To support these missions, the Division’s efforts span multiple technical areas, including RF analog/digital hardware, acoustic hardware, signal processing algorithms, machine learning algorithms, systems analysis, and real-time embedded processor implementation.

The Algorithms, Processing and Experimentation (APEX) Group specializes in development of RF/radar modes, skills and applications, with particular emphasis on advanced signal processing chains and associated algorithm research. We mature these technologies with the objective of implementation, integration, and eventual utility in RF-based systems, typically tailoring our work for highly specific Defense (e.g., Air Force, Space Force, Navy, DARPA, etc.) and Intelligence Community needs.

About the Role:

As an Associate Algorithm and Signal Processing Engineer, you will develop, implement, test, and apply novel signal processing, optimization, and machine learning algorithms for advanced electronic warfare, radar, and remote sensing applications. You will work as part of multidisciplinary teams to research next-generation sensing concepts and transition advanced algorithms into integrated systems for laboratory and field demonstrations.

A successful candidate will have knowledge in one or more of the following areas: signal processing, adaptive radar signal processing, optimization, machine learning, electronic warfare, algorithm development, radar systems, communications systems, RF remote sensing, resource management, modeling and simulation, or related technical fields. This position requires strong analytical skills, scientific programming experience, and the ability to collaborate with researchers, engineers, and customers to solve challenging technical problems.

What You Will Do

- Apply advanced sensing concepts, signal processing algorithms, and machine learning techniques for radar, electronic warfare, and remote sensing applications

- Assist in researching, designing, implementing, and evaluating novel algorithms from concept through demonstration

- Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to architect, develop, integrate, and test advanced RF signal processing systems

- Support modeling and simulation activities to evaluate algorithm performance and inform system design

- Support laboratory and field testing to assess algorithm performance and transition research into operational prototypes

- Contribute to technical proposals, customer interactions, presentations, and technical briefings

- Survey emerging research and incorporate state-of-the-art techniques into practical algorithm solutions.

Who You Are

- Ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is required by the U.S. government

- BS in Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline or equivalent work experience

- Strong programming skills in MATLAB, Python, C/C++, or similar scientific computing languages

- Strong mathematical, analytical, troubleshooting, written, and verbal communication skills

- Ability to develop, implement, test, or analyze signal processing, optimization, or machine learning algorithms

- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

- Ability to translate research objectives and customer needs into practical technical solutions

Even Better

- Active Top Secret security clearance

- Experience with radar systems, RF remote sensing, electronic warfare, or communications systems

- Experience with adaptive signal processing, waveform design, multidimensional signal processing, resource management, or system optimization

- Experience developing algorithms for real-time or embedded systems

- Experience with modeling and simulation, algorithm integration, and system test and evaluation

- Experience with software development and scientific computing workflows

- Ability to survey technical literature, identify emerging approaches, and transition research into integrated, tested solutions

Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $110,000 - $115,000

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

postings.description:
STR is hiring a Systems Administrator with an active Top-Secret clearance to support our Atlanta, GA

Responsibilities:

- Supporting senior administrators in implementing, deploying, and maintaining Linux (Red Hat, CentOS, Ubuntu) and Windows operating systems in traditional and virtualized environments across a variety of hardware solutions

- Supporting Information Systems Security Managers (ISSM), Information System Security Officers (ISSO), senior management, researchers and other team members supporting the customers’ requirements

- Running vulnerability and compliance scanning tools and have the knowledge to remediate the findings

- Performing monthly patching of offline Windows and Linux assets

- Researching and procuring necessary hardware and software components required to complete a task

- Maintaining an accurate inventory of hardware and software licenses.

- Performing hands-on diagnostics at the desktop level, including installing and upgrading software, implementing file backups, and configuring systems and applications.

- Configuring and maintaining NAS Storage, Networking, Firewall, and Directory Services such as MS Active Directory management and Group Policy administration

postings.description:
STR is hiring a Systems Administrator with an Top Secret/SCI with polygraph clearance. Help power the infrastructure behind cutting-edge defense research.

At STR, our Information Technology team plays a critical role in enabling the research and development that supports our national security mission. The team brings together experts across Enterprise IT, Classified IT, and Cybersecurity to build and maintain the secure, reliable infrastructure that powers our organization.

Our Enterprise IT team ensures the performance and availability of the systems that support day-to-day operations, while our Classified IT team manages highly secure environments that protect sensitive government information. Working alongside them, our Cybersecurity team proactively defends our networks and systems against evolving threats. Together, these teams provide the technology foundation that enables STR’s engineers and researchers to develop innovative solutions for national defense.

The Role:

We are seeking a Systems Administrator with an active Secret or Top Secret clearance to support our senior administrators in implementing, deploying, and maintaining Linux (Red Hat, Ubuntu) and Windows operating systems in traditional and virtualized environments across a variety of hardware solutions.

If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure challenges, improving system reliability, and working in a mission-driven environment, we’d love to hear from you. Please note: this position is based in Woburn, Massachusetts only (no other sites, no remote).

- Configure and maintain NAS Storage, Networking, Firewall, and Directory Services such as MS Active Directory management and Group Policy administration

- Perform performance monitoring, results analysis and enhancement, as well as process automation using PowerShell scripting and other available technologies

- Provide daily support, systems maintenance, problem resolution, tracing and project support

- Create and maintain installation and configuration Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

- Maintain current knowledge of DoD security and technical guidelines and the organization's policies

- Provide support for production and development environments

- After-hours support is required for maintenance and patching when needed

Who you Are:

- This position requires an active Top Secret/SCI with polygraph clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is needed by U.S. Government

- Linux Administration (Red Hat, Ubuntu)

- Windows OS Administration

Nice to Haves:

- Enterprise Virtualization Tools

- Multi-Factor Authentication

- Public Key Infrastructure

- Web Server

- Active Directory including Group Policy, LDAP backend, and Replication

- Effective utilization of Security Technical Implementation Guidelines (STIGS) and Security Content Automation Protocol (SCAP) Content and Tools

- Host Based Security System (HBSS) implementation and maintenance

- Assured Compliance Assessment Solution (ACAS) support

- Current knowledge of DoD Ports, Protocols, and Services (PPS)

Bachelor’s degree + 5 years of experience or Master’s degree + 3 years of experience or PhD or equivalent experience.

postings.title: Contractor Special Security Officer (CSSO)
postings.description:
STR seeks an experienced Contractor Special Security Officer (CSSO) to lead a DoW Special Access Program (SAP) portfolio at our Woburn, MA facility. The successful candidate will collaborate with security management, program management, program personnel, and customer security to ensure compliance with U.S. Government directives, regulations, and requirements. Role will primarily manage one DoW SAP customer, with potential future direct reports.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

CSSO Responsibilities (Primary):

- Maintain robust security posture and compliance for multiple SAP programs in accordance with DoDM 5205.07, ICD 705, and IC/DOD security policies

- Serve as primary liaison for SAP program security requirements while providing excellent customer service with internal and external customers

- Partner routinely and effectively with Program Manager and Security disciplines, to include Personnel Security, ACSSOs, Classified Cybersecurity, Classified Information Technology, and the Facility Security Officer

- Lead Government compliance inspections, self-inspections, support staff assistance visits and manage external/internal program security assessments

- Develop, review, and implement security policies, Standard Operating Procedures, Program Protection (P2), and OPSEC/transportation plans

- Oversee document control and classified material accountability, including duties as a SAP Accountability Officer

- Write, interpret, and administer DD254s and support documentation.

- Review operational requirements and system specification documents to ensure applicable security requirements are addressed and incorporated into security processes

- Interpret and implement security classification guidance for each respective program

- Perform inquiries on security incidents and implement corrective actions

- Attend and participate in security and program meetings

- Develop and conduct initial and refresher program security briefings, debriefings, and foreign travel briefings, as required

- Perform other duties as assigned

Who you are:

- This position requires an Active Top Secret security clearance with SAP/SCI eligibility, for which US citizenship is needed by the US Government.

- Minimum 7 years of experience as a security representative with SAP/SCI security compliance

- Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent relevant security experience.

- Demonstrated knowledge of NISPOM, ICD 705, DoDM 5205.07, FOCI, ITAR, and relevant standards

- Proficiency with MS Office, DISS, JADE, SIMS, TALON, and NISS

- Experience in interpreting and implementing security classifications, contracts, and incident response/mitigation

- Successful completion of CDSE’s ‘Intro to SAPs’

- Strong written and oral communication skills; ability to discreetly/diplomatically manage sensitive and complex communications

Key Competencies

- Strong independent judgment and compliance orientation.

- Expertise in security policy interpretation and development.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Ability to manage complex or sensitive communication scenarios.

Physical Demands / Work Environment

- Full Time Onsite position in Woburn, MA

- Ability to stand, bend, move throughout the facility for audits/inspections.

- Occasional travel (approx. 5–10%) as required.

Full-Time Salary Range: $152,000 to $175,000

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

postings.title: Controller, Vice President of Accounting
postings.description:
STR is seeking an experienced and highly qualified Controller to lead our accounting team and oversee all accounting operations and internal controls within the organization. This role requires a hands-on financial leader with a strong background as a Controller, CPA credentials, and substantial experience in both private and public company environments. Experience in the aerospace and defense industry is highly preferred, though not required. This role requires additional in-office presence expected during close periods in the Woburn, MA office.

You will be responsible for the management and development of the financial accounting team of 10+ employees, oversight of financial accounting, technical accounting, cost accounting, accounting strategy, and tax. You’ll take ownership of the monthly and quarterly accounting close processes and balance sheet oversight, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and timeliness. Reporting directly to the CFO, you will be a key player in the company’s journey and will own the buildout of SEC-ready reporting capabilities should the company pursue capital markets opportunities. Join us at a pivotal moment as we scale and prepare for the next chapter of STR’s growth.

Key Responsibilities:

- Lead and manage a team of 10+ accounting professionals, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and collaboration

- Oversee all aspects of financial accounting, tax compliance and planning, balance sheet integrity, technical accounting, and implementation of accounting standards

- Leverage AI and automation tools to enhance accounting processes, improve close efficiency, strengthen controls, and enable the team to focus on higher-value analysis and professional growth

- Direct and refine processes related to cost accounting and technical accounting

- Ensure compliance with US GAAP and government contracting regulations, including FAR, DFARS, and CAS; support DCAA audit requirements as necessary

- Oversee percentage of completion (POC) revenue and profit recognition and Estimate at Completion (EAC) preparation processes compliance and monitoring for government contracts

- Manage and enhance the monthly and quarterly accounting close, including detailed oversight and analysis of balance sheet accounts to ensure accuracy and proper reconciliation

- Manage analysis of actual quarterly and annual financial results of operation, balance sheets, and cash flows, including aligning such analysis with STR’s FP&A process, KPIs and non-GAAP metrics

- Own the preparation and review of complex technical accounting memorandums, policy documentation, and support for new or unusual transactions

- Support proposal development and forward pricing efforts by providing accurate financial modeling, rate forecasts, and margin analysis for bids and contracts

- Oversee the review and finalization of annual incurred cost submissions to government agencies and support government audit processes

- Support and advise management on financial decisions, process improvements, and risk mitigation strategies

- Play a lead role in building scalable financial infrastructure, including systems/controls enhancements, process documentation, and audit readiness to support future strategic alternatives

- Develop public-company-grade reporting processes and the team's ability to produce high-quality disclosures as the company's obligations evolve

- Partner closely with the CFO and executive leadership team on all accounting matters

- Assist and collaborate with the CFO on presentations, reporting and communications for the STR Board of Directors and Audit Committee

- Maintain and develop accounting internal controls consistent with SOX-level rigor, ensuring the organization is prepared for future strategic initiatives

- Serve as the primary point of contact with external auditors, managing audit processes, coordinating deliverables, and ensuring timely resolution of audit findings; coordinate with tax advisors and regulatory bodies as necessary

- Collaborate with the Internal Audit leader to leverage select elements of the annual internal audit plan and scope with the independent auditor’s external audit of the annual STR financial statements 

Required:

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance with current CPA

- Minimum of 15 years of finance experience with progressively responsible accounting roles, including at least 5 years serving as a Controller or in a comparable senior leadership position

- Deep knowledge of US GAAP

- Knowledge and expertise with POC accounting and EAC preparation

- In-depth understanding of SOX/internal controls

- Demonstrated experience managing accounting teams of at least 5 individuals

- Public-company-caliber reporting and controls experience

- Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is required

Preferred:

- Advanced degree (e.g., MBA, MS in Accounting)

- Aerospace and defense industry experience

- Government contract accounting and experience with SEC reporting are a significant plus

- Strong technical accounting skills and experience preparing accounting memorandums and implementing new standards

- Top-tier firm auditing experience

- Experience with government contracting ERP systems

- Proven ability to lead organizations through periods of change and growth

- Strong communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving business environment

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $290,000-$330,000

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

postings.title: Electro-Mechanical Technician Lead
postings.description:
Electromechanical Technician Lead

STR is focused on delivering national defense capabilities by driving mission-focused strategies to develop advanced technology systems that enable enduring products and solutions focused on achieving the customer vision. Our programs deliver sustainable, reliable, and cost-efficient capabilities focused on end-customer needs that function in operationally relevant environments and timeframes. We offer a dynamic and challenging environment where your work directly contributes to national security. 

We are seeking an Electromechanical Technician Lead to support the design, development, testing, and implementation of high-visibility programs across STR. This position will be located in Wilmington, MA for the first year, then move to STR’s Woburn, MA office. As an experienced technician, you will assemble, test, and maintain electrical and electromechanical systems. You will provide feedback to design teams to help improve the assembly and maintenance of the systems as well as aid in troubleshooting and addressing issues. To succeed, you should be able to follow written documentation, read mechanical drawings and electrical schematics, and recommend improvements as an integral part of the design team. As the lead, you will coordinate the daily work of other technicians at the site — communicating duties clearly, checking quality of work, and providing input on performance. This is a working technical lead role, not a supervisory position with direct reports.

If you are driven by a passion for making an impact, excel in a collaborative environment, and are dedicated to the pursuit of excellence, we invite you to apply to join our team. 

 Key Responsibilities: 

- Assemble complex electrical and electromechanical components and systems that will be used in operational environments (e.g., electronic chassis and racks, mechanical assemblies). 

- Fabricate and assemble hardware: wire harnesses; coaxial cable (installation, routing, and restraining); connectors (with wires, strain relief, isolation, and potting); and fastener torquing, staking, and general assembly

- Apply familiarity and experience (e.g., certification) with electronics industry assembly standards such as IPC (Aerospace and Defense applicable standards preferred)

- Support test activities under guidance from Engineering teams, or conduct routine tests independently using test equipment (oscilloscopes, network analyzers, function generators, etc.)

- Read, create, revise, and recommend changes to technical documentation; accurately document work activities to maintain design and manufacturing history; and identify improvements for performance and manufacturability 

- Work and communicate with Engineering staff to understand design intent, communicate issues and recommendations 

- Coordinate day-to-day activities in the assembly bay and work with leadership to maintain and improve lab operations, keeping the environment clean, organized, safe, and fully equipped

- Manage inventory of system parts, materials, electrical supplies, and equipment — ordering, receiving, stocking, and tracking status; coordinating maintenance, calibration, and repair; and scheduling use

- Prepare space for program use — benches, storage, power, network, and ESD mitigation — and handle closeout (pack/return equipment; clean the space) 

- Demonstrate proper equipment use while also ensuring equipment is properly used by others (e.g., verify function, conduct training or direct users to appropriate training) 

- Adhere to standard operating procedures and safety and security protocols, assist in monitoring for adherence, and provide feedback for their development, implementation, and refinement 

- Coordinate with EHS staff to ensure proper storage and disposal of chemicals and waste in accordance with appropriate regulations 

Required Skills and Experience: 

- Associate’s degree in a relevant technical field (electrical, mechanical, etc.) or equivalent experience

- Minimum of 6 years of demonstrated experience assembling, maintaining, testing, and repairing prototype or production systems

- Experience building, testing, and delivering Electromechanical hardware related to RF, Radar, antenna, acoustic, and undersea products 

- Read, interpret, and refine work instructions, assembly drawings, and documentation

- Excellent independent problem-solving skills 

- Familiarity with tools and parts used in assembly of Electromechanical hardware, including solder, soldering irons, and crimp tools; drill press, saws, and related power tools; bolts, nuts, washers, and related mechanical hardware; and connectors, wire preparation, and epoxies

- Experience with Microsoft 365 tools (Word, Excel, Teams)

- Ability to stand, bend, and lift up to 50 lbs 

- Ability to work from and operate a forklift, scissor lift or elevated work platform

- Occasional travel (<10% per year) 

- This position requires the ability to obtain a security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is required

Even Better: 

- Experience with data management systems (Arena, SolidWorks PDM) 

- Fine pitch soldering experience for assembly or repair of circuit card assemblies

- Existing IPC certifications (e.g., IPC J-STD-001, IPC-A-610, IPC-7711/7721) preferred or ability to obtain required certifications. Expired certifications are acceptable; however, skills must have been applied within the last 2 years 

- Experience with high-power RF assembly, testing, and safety

- Experience with large hardware assembly and verification, following test plans and using lab test equipment

- Active Secret or Top-Secret clearance

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $84,000 to $125,000

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

postings.title: Embedded Systems Emulation Engineer
postings.description:
STR is hiring an Embedded Systems Emulation Engineer to join our multidisciplinary team of researchers and engineers developing cutting-edge technologies with significant and immediate impact on our national security. In this role, you will work at the intersection of computer systems and real-world physical systems, building the tools and models that emulate complex cyber-physical platforms to enable analysis, reverse engineering, and experimentation.

We believe every employee brings a unique set of skills, experiences, and perspectives that are essential to providing innovative solutions for our customers. You do not need to have experience with every technology listed to be successful in this role. Strong fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn new tools and domains are highly valued.

What you will do: 

- Work as part of a small, focused team to architect, develop, implement, and test modular software applications and tools for emulating cyber-physical systems.

- Extend and customize existing emulation frameworks (e.g., QEMU) in C/C++ and Python to support new targets, peripherals, and capabilities.

- Rehost unknown or sparsely documented firmware by analyzing binaries, identifying hardware dependencies, and adapting these to run correctly in emulated environments.

- Develop emulator tooling and virtual device models to support reverse engineering and analysis of embedded systems across diverse architectures (e.g., ARM, PPC).

- Develop digital models using virtualization tools (e.g., QEMU) and network them together to create integrated, end-to-end system simulations that closely approximate real hardware behavior.

- Ensure model quality and correctness through unit-level and system-level testing, and by validating behavior against first principles, measured data, documentation, and hardware/software artifacts.

- Communicate technical foundations of models and algorithms through reports and briefings

Who you are:

- This position requires an Active Secret security clearance with eligibility for Top Secret (TS) clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is needed by U.S. Government. 

- Proficiency in C/C++ for systems-level or embedded software development

- Proficiency in Python for tool development, automation, and integration

- Familiarity with emulation and virtualization tools (e.g., QEMU or similar frameworks)

- Strong understanding of computer architecture, emulation principles, and software engineering best practices (e.g., modular design, testing, code review)

- Experience using collaborative source code management (e.g., Git)

Education:

- BS in Computer Engineering, Computers Science, Electrical Engineering or related field

Nice to have:

- Active Top Secret (TS) Security Clearance

- Familiarity with network architecture and protocols, and experience integrating networked simulations

- Experience with low-level software modifications (e.g., implants, firmware changes, binary patch development)

- Experience at the software/hardware interface, including device drivers or real-time/embedded operating systems

- Experience with reverse engineering and firmware rehosting for embedded systems, including analysis of instruction set architectures (e.g., ARM, PPC) and use of tools such as Ghidra, IDA Pro, or Binary Ninja

- Experience implementing component models (e.g., sensors, actuators, dynamics, environmental factors) in Python and/or C/C++, and integrate them into system-level simulations and software processing chains

- Experience working with hardware components and interfaces

- Masters or PhD in related field

Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $110,000 - $151,000

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

- Proficiency in Python for tool development, automation, and integration

postings.title: Lead Algorithm & Signal Processing Engineer
postings.description:
About the Team:

The Electronic Warfare and Novel Capabilities Group (EWNC) develops and delivers advanced signal processing algorithms and prototype systems for next-generation radar and electronic warfare technologies.

EWNC fosters a culture of innovation and collaboration. We investigate cutting edge technologies and interface with engineers across sectors and divisions at STR and researchers at academic institutions and industry partners to develop practical and effective solutions to RF sensing and counter-sensing challenges. If you're seeking an opportunity to apply your deep technical knowledge and creativity to make a lasting impact, we invite you to join us.

The Role:

As a Lead Algorithm & Signal Processing Researcher, you'll have the opportunity to develop state-of-the-art algorithms and techniques for sense making and sensor decision making, from signal detection and classification, to electronic support measures, attack, and protection, to cognitive EW and more.

What You Will Do:

- Design and apply cutting-edge signal processing and machine learning techniques to solve complex radar and RF sensing and counter-sensing challenges

- Design and implement models and simulations for advanced RF systems

- Lead small teams and projects

- Support business development and proposal writing efforts

- Collaborate with diverse teams to deploy cutting-edge capabilities to prototype systems

Who You Are:

- This position requires the ability to obtain a Top Secret security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is needed by U.S. Government

- BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or related technical discipline

- 5-7+ years of relevant work experience depending on degree (BS +7 years or MS +5 years)

- Experience in two or more of the following areas:

- RF/radar signal processing, optimization, waveform design, electronic warfare, machine learning, adaptive signal processing, AI/ML algorithm development, algorithm development, test & evaluation, model & simulation, or systems engineering, test engineering, radar modelling, or RF systems prototyping

- Proficiency in one or more scientific or mathematical programming languages, such as MATLAB, Python, and C/C++

- Strong mathematical, troubleshooting, written, and verbal communication skills

Even Better:

- Active Security Clearance

- Experience with:

- RF technologies in the defense sector, particularly for sensing and electronic warfare applications including electronic attack, electronic protection, cognitive EW, and advanced electronic support measures techniques and algorithms

- Machine learning tasks such as natural language processing, image recognition, semantic segmentation, reinforcement learning, approaches such as Bayesian, deep convolutional and graph neural network methods, and tools such as PyTorch, Ray, TensorFlow/board, and MLflow

- Interacting with decision-makers and customers to translate mission needs into an end-to-end analytical solutio

- Ability to apply novel, innovative and interdisciplinary approaches to challenging engineering problems

- Ability to create and present briefings to customers and senior management to provide both high-level and deep technical solution explanations 

Join EWNC and help shape the future of RF sensing and electronic warfare by developing innovative technologies that transition from advanced research into operational prototype systems. postings.title: Lead Applied AI Engineer
postings.description:
About the Team

STR’s Intelligence Division researches, develops, and transitions advanced analytics and machine-learning solutions for challenging national-security problems. Our team includes engineers and researchers with advanced backgrounds in engineering, computer science, mathematics, and data science who apply deep technical expertise and creativity to mission-critical challenges.

Our work spans data analysis, deep learning, and statistical methods across networking, communications, social media, text, time series, geospatial, and imagery data. We develop capabilities under constraints not typically encountered in commercial environments. U.S. Government analysts use our tools and technologies to extract, enrich, and act on intelligence information worldwide.

The Role

As a Lead Applied AI Engineer, you will lead the technical development and delivery of RF AI/ML-based tools, algorithms, and software integrated with physical hardware, sensors, and compute, focusing on Radio Frequency (RF) communications, Open RAN, 5G/6G communications, waveform generation/adaptation, and wireless communications and networking infrastructure. You will lead the design, implementation, integration, test, demonstration, and transition of mission-relevant software spanning data processing, AI/ML models, communications services, and edge or on-premises compute environments.

You will own technical delivery for an assigned project or major subsystem, translating mission needs into executable plans and guiding architecture, implementation, integration, verification, and transition. You will work closely with software engineers, systems engineers, RF/communications researchers, DevSecOps personnel, and mission partners to develop scalable, secure, maintainable capabilities for complex customer environments.

This is a technical leadership role. You will define and decompose technical work, lead assigned engineers and contributors, manage technical interfaces and risks, and communicate progress, decisions, and tradeoffs to the Principal Investigator, project team, and mission partners.

What You Will Do

- Lead project execution: Lead development and delivery of AI/ML, RF sensing, and communications/networking capabilities from requirements definition through implementation, integration, test, demonstration, deployment, and sustainment

- Translate mission needs into plans: Convert customer objectives into requirements, architectures, development plans, milestones, performance measures, and acceptance criteria. Architect and evaluate AI/ML-enabled RF, communications, and networking solutions, including 5G/6G AI-RAN capabilities, against mission performance, latency, reliability, spectrum efficiency, security, and deployability needs.

- Lead the technical team: Lead and mentor engineers and researchers; collaborate with systems engineers, RF/communications researchers, DevSecOps personnel and mission partners; and communicate technical status, decisions, risks, and tradeoffs

- Manage technical work: Decompose complex work into actionable tasks and subtasks; manage dependencies, technical risks, interfaces, and progress toward program objectives

- Own project architecture: Design and oversee architectures spanning RF and sensor-data pipelines, AI/ML integrations, services, APIs, databases, user interfaces, Open RAN integrations, and deployment infrastructure. Lead development of RF sensing and communications capabilities such as spectrum sensing, signal classification, interference mitigation, channel estimation, beam management, adaptive links, and passive-radar processing, as applicable to project needs

- Drive integration and quality: Lead design reviews, code reviews, integration, testing, customer demonstrations, and release readiness. Ensure systems meet reliability, security, maintainability, and performance requirements, including high-throughput, low-latency edge AI workflows (e.g., Layer 1/Layer 2 functions) where applicable

- Support growth and transition: Contribute technical content to proposals, customer engagements, and transition planning while ensuring delivered capabilities are reusable and mission relevant

Who You Are

- Education and experience: PhD with 2+ years, MS with 6+ years, or BS with 8+ years of relevant experience in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, or a related technical discipline.

- Clearance eligibility: Ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret security clearance, for which U.S citizenship is needed by the U.S government

- Technical delivery leadership: Experience leading software development efforts, major workstreams, or complex subsystems. Ability to define tasks and subtasks, coordinate contributors, manage technical interfaces and risks, and communicate progress and tradeoffs to stakeholders

- Systems engineering: Experience translating customer needs into requirements, designs, development and test plans, and integrated capabilities. Experience managing interfaces among software, AI/ML, RF, communications, hardware, data, and deployment components

- AI/ML and Communications experience: Experience applying AI/ML to operational problems involving sensor, time-series, RF, communications, or other non-textual data. Experience with RF signal processing, wireless communications, 5G/6G RAN, O-RAN/AI-RAN, waveform generation/adaptation, or edge AI is strongly preferred

- Software development: Proficiency in Python, C++, Java, Go, or a similar language, with experience developing and maintaining production-quality software

- Engineering practices: Experience with Git, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, issue tracking, documentation, and secure software-development practices

- Communication and collaboration: Ability to lead technical discussions, communicate risks and tradeoffs, and work effectively with customers and multidisciplinary teams

Even Better

- Active clearance: Active Secret, Top Secret, or TS/SCI security clearance

- Architecture experience: Experience designing system or software architectures for distributed, data-intensive, real-time, cloud, on-premises, edge, RF sensing, or communications systems

- RF and wireless systems: Experience with digital signal processing, software-defined radios, PHY/MAC processing, or RF sensing

- AI-RAN and edge deployment: Familiarity with 5G/6G or Open RAN architectures and deployment of optimized models to edge AI/ML accelerators

- Real-time communications software: Experience developing high-throughput, latency-sensitive software for PHY, MAC, scheduling, or radio-resource management

- DevSecOps experience: Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure automation, container orchestration, cloud platforms, monitoring, logging, and security tooling

- Large codebase experience: Experience developing software in large, multi-team codebases using collaborative engineering practices

- Decentralized systems: Familiarity with message queues, stream processing, distributed computing, or microservices

- Customer and capture support: Experience supporting technical proposals, customer demonstrations, technical briefings, or capture activities with DoW or IC customers

- Modern development tools: Experience using LLM-enabled development tools, such as Cursor or Codex, in a secure and effective engineering workflow

Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $180,000 - $230,000

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

postings.description:
STR is hiring a Lead Cyber AI Engineer to apply modern AI capabilities—including Large Language Models (LLMs), agents, tool harnesses, and automation—to accelerate reverse engineering, vulnerability research, digital modeling, embedded software development, and cybersecurity analysis of cyber-physical systems.

This role is for an engineer with hands-on low-level cyber experience who can build practical AI-enabled workflows for software, firmware, binaries, embedded systems, and cyber-physical targets. You will join a multidisciplinary team of researchers and engineers developing cutting-edge technologies with significant and immediate impact on national security.

This is not a general AI-product, chatbot, or data-science position. Candidates must have practical experience in one or more cyber disciplines—such as reverse engineering, vulnerability research, firmware analysis, fuzzing, emulation, digital modeling, or embedded software development—and use AI to improve those workflows.

We welcome candidates whose expertise was developed through industry experience, advanced academic research, or a combination of both.

Work must be performed onsite. An Active Top Secret (TS) security clearance is required.

What You’ll Do

- Develop and apply AI-enabled workflows that accelerate reverse engineering, vulnerability research, firmware analysis, digital modeling, embedded software development, and cyber-physical-system analysis.

- Design and build LLM-based agents, tool harnesses, and research automation for tasks such as binary triage, code and data-flow analysis, protocol reconstruction, documentation, and vulnerability investigation.

- Integrate AI-enabled tooling with disassemblers, decompilers, debuggers, fuzzers, emulators, databases, and custom research platforms.

- Build scripts, plugins, APIs, and automation tools that allow AI workflows to retrieve approved research artifacts, invoke analysis tools, preserve workflow state, and present findings for researcher review.

- Develop skills, tool interfaces, structured outputs, tests, and benchmark datasets that improve the reliability and technical accuracy of AI-assisted workflows.

- Implement safeguards for AI-enabled systems in sensitive environments, including human review, controlled tool execution, audit logging, access control, and reproducible workflows.

- Conduct hands-on reverse engineering, vulnerability research, debugging, firmware analysis, digital modeling, or low-level software development to ensure that AI-enabled capabilities solve real researcher problems.

- Work with cyber researchers, engineers, program leadership, and customers to develop, demonstrate, document, and transition innovative cybersecurity capabilities.

Who You Are:

- This position requires an Active Top Secret security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is needed by the U.S. Government.

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, Electrical Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related technical field, plus 7+ years of relevant experience. Equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered. Candidates with a relevant MS or PhD and demonstrated hands-on experience in cyber research, reverse engineering, vulnerability research, embedded systems, digital modeling, or AI-enabled technical tooling are strongly encouraged to apply.

- Hands-on experience in one or more of the following: reverse engineering, binary analysis, vulnerability research, embedded or firmware development, fuzzing, emulation, dynamic analysis, digital modeling, simulation, or cyber-physical-system analysis.

- Proficiency in Python and one or more systems programming languages, such as C or C++.

- Experience using or developing low-level analysis tools, such as IDA Pro, Ghidra, Binary Ninja, GDB, QEMU, Frida, AFL++, libFuzzer, or equivalent custom tooling.

- Working knowledge of low-level systems and reverse-engineering concepts, including binary formats, memory layout, calling conventions, control flow, data flow, and debugging without source code.

- Experience applying LLMs, agents, AI-assisted automation, or equivalent modern AI capabilities to technical workflows.

- Experience integrating software tools through APIs, command-line interfaces, plugins, scripting interfaces, or custom tool harnesses.

- Strong technical judgment, including an understanding that AI-generated output requires validation, controlled execution, repeatability, and human oversight.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Nice to Have:

- Experience applying AI to reverse engineering, vulnerability research, malware or firmware analysis, fuzzing, exploitability assessment, or cyber-physical-system security.

- Experience building custom agent harnesses, multi-agent workflows, MCP servers, tool-calling interfaces, or AI integrations with reverse-engineering platforms.

- Experience with LLM structured outputs, function calling, tool use, evaluation, context management, or failure analysis.

- Experience developing custom emulation tools, fuzzing harnesses, reverse-engineering plugins, automated analysis pipelines, or digital models.

- Experience with embedded systems, firmware, IoT devices, industrial-control systems, DSP architectures, or nontraditional processor architectures and operating systems.

- Knowledge of exploit mitigations, operating-system internals, binary emulation, symbolic execution, or dynamic analysis.

- Experience creating evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, observability tools, or tracing systems for AI-enabled workflows.

- Experience with technical proposals, customer demonstrations, CTFs, open-source security tooling, or technical publications.

Full-Time Salary Range: $157,000 - $224,000

postings.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
postings.description:
About the Team 

The Sensors Division at STR focuses on technology development for advanced sensor systems and platforms in support of national security. The Systems Autonomy, Analysis, and Modeling (SAAM) Group within the Sensors Division develops, adapts, and applies cutting-edge autonomy research to solve real-world problems on the foundation of physics-based modeling and simulation. Algorithmic areas of interest include: AI/ML, controls theory, sensor signal processing (especially radar and EO/IR), tracking, optimization, and resource allocation. Application domains include: manned air platforms (e.g., the F-35 Joint Simulation Environment), unmanned air platforms, and space assets, primarily for the Air Force and Navy as well as DARPA research programs.

The Role: 

One of the SAAM group’s projects is beginning to transition an AI/ML-based solution to a Government environment. The R&D team will continue to upgrade the core AI/ML product. You have experience managing relationships with customer environments while simultaneously leading engineering teams to ensure the delivered product meets the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance. You will work as part of tightly knit Agile software teams to design and implement Continuous Integration/ Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for various unique deployment environments.  This role includes:  

- Supporting cloud (e.g., AWS) toolsets in unclassified environments  

- Configuring and maintaining multiple CI/CD environments at different classification levels, focusing on developer productivity, application performance, security monitoring, and alerting  

- Liaising with corporate IT to ensure team infrastructure toolsets are configured, maintained, reliable, and in compliance with Department of Defense standards  

- Coaching team members on DevOps best practices while continuously helping to improve processes.  

  This role will take advantage of STR’s flexible, hybrid environment – when the work does not require use of STR’s facilities, you are welcome to work remotely. You should expect to spend some portion of time every week (2-3 days) in STR’s or US Government facilities.  You can expect to support software applications deployed on classified operational networks that can only be accessed at STR or government facilities.

- Must be a U.S. citizen 

- Active US Security Clearance with SCI Eligibility 

- BS in Computer Science or related field with at least 5 years of work experience

- CI/CD tools (Gitlab) and pipeline automation  

- Cloud platforms (such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), and automated provisioning tools (such as Ansible or Chef)  

- Containerization technologies such as Docker and Podman  

- Kubernetes management solutions such as EKS and Rancher  

- Experience deploying, and monitoring Kubernetes clusters and pod configurations  

- Basic knowledge of Linux System Administration  

- Knowledge of Python and Linux Shell  

- Knowledge of Cyber Security fundamentals  

- Organized, detail-oriented, and ability to work both independently and collaboratively  

- Demonstrated experience as an effective communicator to both technical and non-technical audiences  

- Located in San Diego, CA, Denver, CO, Arlington, VA, or Boston, MA, or willing to relocate. 

 Even Better: 

- Active Security Clearance at the Top Secret level 

- Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field 

- Experience in:  

- Full web-service stack, including databases, logging, and monitoring  

- Project tracking tools such as Jira  

- Designing, deploying, and monitoring Kubernetes clusters  

- GitOps tools like ArgoCD or Flux  

- Deploying and maintaining artifact repositories (such as Nexus, Artifactory)  

- Deploying and configuring static and dynamic code analysis tools (such as SonarQube, Coverity).  

- Platforms such as ArgoCD, Flux or TerraForm.  

- Leading teams in an Agile/SCRUM software development process  

- Current Security+ Certification

The Team: 

Information processing and sense-making systems are the lifeblood of national security efforts, facilitating an understanding of the global situation, strategic planning, and tactical execution. The Mission Applications (MA) Group within the AC2 Division creates outsized mission impact with our customers through specialized application and deployment of STR technology. MA staff combine with other engineering staff from the various STR research and development groups to form dedicated product teams focused on accelerating the operational transition of cutting-edge software technologies. 

 The Role: 

As a DevOps Engineer in the Mission Applications Group, you will work as a leader of software teams to design, develop, and maintain infrastructure and tooling to deploy software in operational use. You have experience managing relationships with customer environments while simultaneously leading engineering teams to ensure the delivered product meets the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance. You will work as part of tightly knit Agile software teams to design and implement Continuous Integration/ Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for various unique deployment environments.  This role includes:  

- Supporting cloud (e.g., AWS) toolsets in unclassified environments  

- Configuring and maintaining multiple CI/CD environments at different classification levels, focusing on developer productivity, application performance, security monitoring, and alerting  

- Liaising with corporate IT to ensure team infrastructure toolsets are configured, maintained, reliable, and in compliance with Department of Defense standards  

- Coaching team members on DevOps best practices while continuously helping to improve processes.  

  This role will take advantage of STR’s flexible, hybrid environment – when the work does not require use of STR’s facilities, you are welcome to work remotely. You should expect to spend some portion of time every week (2-3 days) in STR’s or US Government facilities.  You can expect to support software applications deployed on classified operational networks that can only be accessed at STR or government facilities.

- Must be a U.S. citizen 

- Active US Security Clearance with SCI Eligibility 

- BS in Computer Science or related field with at least 5 years of work experience 

- Experience with all relevant technologies including:

- Cloud platforms (such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), and automated provisioning tools (such as Ansible or Chef)  

- Containerization technologies such as Docker and Podman  

- Kubernetes management solutions such as EKS and Rancher  

- Experience deploying, and monitoring Kubernetes clusters and pod configurations  

- Basic knowledge of Linux System Administration  

- Knowledge of Python and Linux Shell  

- Knowledge of Cyber Security fundamentals  

- Organized, detail-oriented, and ability to work both independently and collaboratively  

- Demonstrated experience as an effective communicator to both technical and non-technical audiences  

- Located in San Diego, CA, Denver, CO, Arlington, VA, or Boston, MA, or willing to relocate. 

 Even Better: 

- Active Security Clearance at the Top Secret level 

- Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field 

- Experience in:  

- Full web-service stack, including databases, logging, and monitoring  

- Project tracking tools such as Jira  

- Designing, deploying, and monitoring Kubernetes clusters  

- GitOps tools like ArgoCD or Flux  

- Deploying and maintaining artifact repositories (such as Nexus, Artifactory)  

- Deploying and configuring static and dynamic code analysis tools (such as SonarQube, Coverity).  

- Platforms such as ArgoCD, Flux or TerraForm.  

- Leading teams in an Agile/SCRUM software development process  

- Current Security+ Certification

postings.title: Lead Digital Hardware Engineer
postings.description:
Digital Hardware Engineer 

About the Team:

The STR Sensors Division specializes in the development of advanced sensor systems, with a particular focus on airborne and surface-based radar, space-based sensing, electronic warfare, and underwater acoustics. This position is within the Space Missions and Sensing (SMS) Sector of the Sensors Division.

STR’s Space Missions and Sensing (SMS) Sector’s mission is to develop and apply innovative technology to space-based sensing, space control, and counter-sensing. Within the SMS Sector, the Space and Counter Space (SCS) team is at the forefront in electronic warfare technologies. Our team strives to bring critical and transformational capabilities to the warfighter through creative ideas and techniques. To realize the value, the team develops both engineering and operational prototypes to demonstrate capabilities in real world environments. 

We take pride in our ability to address warfighter operational needs. Our core team includes principal investigators, program managers, signal processors, SW developers, FPGA expertise, RF and Electromagnetic engineers, and mechanical design experts. Our facilities support on site build and test (benchtop, anechoic chamber, and over the air). We collaborate with a dynamic group of research engineers across STR, academic researchers, and industry partners to develop practical and effective solutions to RF sensing and counter-sensing challenges.

Driven by our strong performance the work is expanding. We are seeking individuals with program management experience and interest in being part of a system of systems work program encompassing both new capabilities and operational prototype systems. If you're seeking an opportunity to apply your program management skills while contributing to a work program strategic vision, we invite you to join us. 

The Role:

The SMS Sector is seeking a Digital Hardware Engineer. This role will be supporting engineering development, integration, and demonstration efforts for complex electronic systems. Candidate will collaborate with a dynamic engineering development team leading system and subsystem prototype efforts for complex digital circuit cards and modules. The successful candidate must have strong technical aptitude, communication skills and ability to work well across the engineering team. 

 to lead small teams to design, develop, integrate and test novel sensing and counter sensing systems for radar, electronic warfare, and signal processing systems. This position offers significant opportunities for career growth within a fast-paced and rapidly expanding company.

What you will do:

- Design of complex high speed digital circuit card assemblies across a range of platforms and form factors, including custom boards, test boards, evaluation-kit integration, and COTS system-on-modules (SoMs) integrated into custom carrier boards.

- Lead and work with small, multi-disciplinary teams to design, build, and test hardware systems. Systems are predominantly field deployable prototypes with the objective of transitioning to low-volume product systems.

- Lead the team to quantify goals, system performance objectives, metrics, dependencies, and risks to guide your work. 

- Support test and troubleshooting of systems, modules, and sub-assemblies of digital modules.

- Perform signal-integrity, power-integrity, and timing analysis, and define stackups and design constraints to meet performance, reliability, and manufacturability requirements.

- Generate and review test procedures, drawings, engineering specifications, reports, and other documentation.

- Conduct digital system performance trade studies and analyses of proposed architectures to develop, derive, and verify requirements. Conduct performance analysis through simulations and real-world testing to validate system performance.

- Interface with government sponsors and suppliers as necessary.

- Mentor peers and more junior engineers in areas of expertise.

Who you are:

- This position requires the ability to obtain a security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is required by U.S. Government. Active Secret Clearance HIGHLY PREFERRED.

- BS in Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical discipline 

- PhD + 2 years, MS + 5 years, or BS + 7 years of experience in digital circuit card design assemblies and working with design, build, integration and test of complex electronic systems.

- Experience defining digital interfaces, clocking schemes, and system architecture for hardware built around microcontrollers, FPGAs/SoCs, and data-converter ICs.

- Experience with high-speed digital interfaces (e.g., PCIe, SerDes, Ethernet, DDR) and with signal-integrity analysis.

- Experience working with CAD based schematic capture and simulation tools such as Altium Designer.

- Familiarity collaborating on RF systems and subsystems.

- Proficiency in MATLAB and/or Python and/or other higher-level languages 

- Strong Mathematical, troubleshooting, written, and verbal communication skills 

Even Better:

- Advanced degree in Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical discipline  

- Excellent problem-solving skills, judgement, and analytical capability

- Motivated self-starter with leaderships kills and ability to effectively work in a team environment

- Ability to apply novel, innovative and interdisciplinary approaches to challenging engineering problems  

- Ability to create and present briefings to customers and senior management to provide both high-level and deep technical solution explanations 

Join us and be part of a team that's making an impact at the forefront of technology and innovation.

postings.description:
STR’s Cyber Division is hiring a Lead Firmware Engineer to implement complex system algorithms and interfaces in FPGAs for Radar and EW systems. Applicable projects span all levels of maturity from initial concept generation through design, prototype, development, test, and transition to production. In this role, you will implement, test, and verify designs through simulation and lab test. These FPGA designs could include signal processing across very wide bands, high data rate interfaces, serial interfaces, and complex control logic.

Additionally, you will support the effort to evaluate current and future system capabilities, identify improved applications and techniques, and ultimately recommend solutions. This position requires skills in working with multidisciplinary teams, supporting development and test activities, as well as technical proficiency in relevant technologies. Strong interpersonal, communication, and technical skills are also required. Applicants are expected to be self-motivated, detail oriented and have a demonstrated ability to effectively communicate with all levels of management and individual contributors on the program team through strong written and verbal communication skills. 

What you will do:

- Mapping system-level requirements and objectives to FPGA specifications

- Validating designs with simulation and verification techniques before hardware integration

- Participating in FPGA development process improvement

- Supporting full life cycle of development and integration of FPGA firmware into hardware systems

- Creating and maintaining design documentation and test plans

- Delivering technical briefings to a range of internal and external stakeholders

- Coordinating with program managers and technical leads to manage task schedules and budgets

- Providing mentorship to more junior engineers to accelerate their technical and professional development

- Building and maintaining high-performing and empowered technical teams

Who you are:

- This position requires an Active Top Secret (TS) security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is needed by U.S. Government

- Bachelor’s degree and at least 7 years of applicable experience, a Master’s degree and at least 5 years of applicable experience, or PhD and at least 2 years of applicable experience. Equivalent experience will be considered.

- Experience with FPGA and SoC design entry using Verilog or VHDL

- Experience with design flow for Xilinx and/or Intel FPGAs

- Experience with simulation tools such as ModelSim/Questa, VCS, or Incisive

- Demonstrated desire to successfully pursue new challenges, improve and broaden technical skills, seek greater responsibilities, and increase individual value to the organization

- Capable of effectively working in a team environment, often under tight deadlines

Nice to Haves:

- Active Top Secret Security Clearance

- Proficient with Xilinx or Altera SoC platforms

- Proficient with FPGA or ASIC RTL design entry

- Strong background and experience with industry best practices and version control

- Proficient with complex timing closure

- Experience with Matlab, Python, or C/C++

- Experience with interfacing to high speed DACs and ADCs

- Experience with Digital Signal Processing

- Understanding of RF Systems, specifically radar or EW

- Experience performing FPGA reverse engineering work within a team to identify behavioral details of an application

postings.title: Lead GPU Software Engineer
postings.description:
About the Team:

The Sensors Division at STR focuses on technology development for advanced sensor systems, particularly in the areas of airborne/surface-based radar, electronic warfare, underwater acoustics, hyperspectral imaging, and EO/IR sensing. Within this role, we perform work on full system prototypes, experiment campaigns and technology component development. Development roles within the Sensors Division include RF analog/digital hardware, acoustic hardware, signal processing algorithms, machine learning algorithms, tracking/fusion, as well as real-time embedded processor implementation.

Within the Sensors Division, the Real-time Architectures, Integration and Demonstration (RAID) Group focuses on transition of algorithms from concept to real-time software, providing open architecture expertise, and facilitating integration of capabilities for experimentation, test, and deployment.

The Role:

The RAID Group is seeking a Lead Software Engineer with demonstrated expertise in GPU programming and optimization to design, develop, and implement real-time software for RF sensor systems compliant with open architecture standards. You will work as part of focused teams to transition advanced signal processing algorithms from research prototypes into production-quality software for embedded and distributed computing platforms. You will be responsible for architecting software components, implementing real-time processing pipelines, and optimizing performance for resource-constrained systems.

A successful candidate will have experience developing high-performance C/C++ software for sensor systems. Strong understanding of real-time systems, multithreaded programming, and signal processing are essential. Experience with open architecture frameworks and standards is highly desired. Strong technical, interpersonal, and communication skills are important for working in collaborative, multi-disciplinary teams.

What you will do:

- Design and implement real-time software components for RF sensor signal processing systems

- Develop and optimize GPU-accelerated algorithms for signal processing pipelines using CUDA

- Translate algorithm specifications (MATLAB, Python) into optimized C/C++ implementations

- Architect software components compliant with open architecture standards

- Integrate and optimize code for real-time performance on multi-core CPUs and GPUs with strict latency requirements

- Develop unit tests, integration tests, and performance benchmarks; promote testing best practices

- Document software designs, APIs, implementation details, and technical reports

- Contribute to briefings and presentations for program reviews and customer meetings

- Collaborate with algorithm developers, systems engineers, RF hardware engineers, and integration teams across programs

- Contribute to proposal development efforts including technical approach

- Perform peer reviews and suggest next steps for technical work

- Support approximately 20% travel for integration events, customer meetings, and field demonstrations

Who you are:

- Ability to obtain and retain a Secret Security Clearance, for which U.S Citizenship is needed by the U.S government

- PhD + 2 years, MS + 5 years, or BS + 7 years in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field

- Experience with GPU programming and optimization (CUDA)

- Strong proficiency in C/C++ for high-performance, real-time applications

- Experience with Linux and embedded systems development

- Experience with real-time signal processing

- Experience with multithreaded programming, thread safety, and synchronization

- Experience with version control systems (Git) and collaborative development practices

- Good technical writing and communication skills
