postings.title: Lead Mission Engineer - Full Stack
postings.description:
About the Team: 

Information processing and sense-making systems are the lifeblood of national security efforts, facilitating an understanding of the global situation, strategic planning, and tactical execution. The reliability, accessibility, and sophistication of these systems can determine the outcomes of conflicts before they begin. STR’s Analytics and Command & Control (AC2) Division focuses on developing actionable, advanced technology solutions to provide asymmetric advantages within the information domain. 

The Mission Applications (MA) Group within the AC2 Division specializes in ensuring the technology that STR creates produces outsized mission impact. Staff within the MA group have a deep understanding of missions and technology needs for national security with skills targeting transition of technology to operational use, including product management, UX Product implementation, software integration & mission engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, and program management. MA staff combine with other science and engineering staff from the various STR research and development groups to form dedicated product teams focused on accelerating the operational transition of cutting-edge software technologies. 

The Role: 

As a Mission Engineer (Full Stack) in the Mission Applications Group, you will develop and deploy software essential for a specific, real-world objective or "mission" in partnership with our customers. You have: 1) expertise in developing and deploying software solutions in complex and high-security environments, 2) deep domain knowledge in the complex missions executed across the Department of Defense, and 3) expertise in modern frameworks, building full stack applications, and integrating APIs for deployment in high-security environments. 

You will work as a leader of software teams to design, develop, and maintain software systems deployed in operational use. You have experience managing customer relationships while simultaneously leading engineering teams to ensure the delivered product meets the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance. 

What you will do:

- Build Prototype Capabilities: Break down use cases and user-defined problems, build an MVP, and rapidly evolve a solution into a cohesive application

- Develop and Enhance Features: Create high-performance, visually appealing frontend solutions that handle complex use cases effectively. Ensure the product is fast, smooth, and intuitive to use, even under heavy load

- System Integration: Leading cross functional engineering teams to design, build, and deploy a cohesive system. Integrate independent capabilities into existing solutions

- Customer Collaboration: Working closely with end-users and customers, who are typically military or Government operators, to understand their requirements and translate them into software features. You are experienced in product discovery best practices

- Deployment and Field Testing: Traveling to integration sites to deploy, test, and triage software in secure operational environments. On average, travel to customer sites should not exceed one week per month 

Who You Are: 

- Active Secret Security Clearance with the ability to obtain Top Secret level with SCI Eligibility

- BS in Computer Science or related technical field with at least 7 years of work experience. Equivalent experience will be considered

- Experience deploying software for DoD or IC missions

- A passion for crafting user-centric interfaces and a keen eye for design details

- Demonstrated strong knowledge of modern technologies such as React, TypeScript, and Python

- Knowledge of performance-focused tools and techniques for rendering large datasets and building responsive, smooth interfaces

- A demonstrated ability to adopt new languages, libraries, and technologies

- Organized, detail-oriented, and with an ability to work both independently and collaboratively

- Demonstrated experience as an effective communicator to both technical and non-technical audiences 

Even Better: 

- Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related technical field

- Prior US Military Service with experience in joint planning, large force battle monitoring, and fluidity with large force debrief best practices

- Located in San Diego, CA, Denver, CO, Arlington, VA, or Boston, MA, or willing to relocate 

Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $175,000 - $240,000

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

Information processing and sense-making systems are the lifeblood of national security efforts, facilitating an understanding of the global situation, strategic planning, and tactical execution. STR’s Analytics and Command & Control (AC2) Division focuses on developing actionable, advanced technology solutions to provide asymmetric advantages within the information domain. 

The Mission Applications (MA) Group within the AC2 Division specializes in ensuring the technology that STR creates produces outsized mission impact. Staff within the MA group have a deep understanding of missions and technology needs for national security with skills targeting transition of technology to operational use, including product management, UX Product implementation, software integration & mission engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, and program management. MA staff combine with other science and engineering staff from the various STR research and development groups to form dedicated product teams focused on accelerating the operational transition of cutting-edge software technologies. 

The Role: 

As a Mission Engineer (Full Stack) in the Mission Applications Group, you will develop and deploy software essential for a specific, real-world objective or "mission" in partnership with our customers. You have: 1) expertise in developing and deploying software solutions in complex and high-security environments, 2) deep domain knowledge in the complex missions executed across the Department of Defense, and 3) expertise in modern frameworks, building full stack applications, and integrating APIs for deployment in high-security environments. 

You will work as a leader of software teams to design, develop, and maintain software systems deployed in operational use. You have experience managing customer relationships while simultaneously leading engineering teams to ensure the delivered product meets the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance. 

What you will do:

- Build Prototype Capabilities: Break down use cases and user-defined problems, build an MVP, and rapidly evolve a solution into a cohesive application

- Develop and Enhance Features: Create high-performance, visually appealing frontend solutions that handle complex use cases effectively. Ensure the product is fast, smooth, and intuitive to use, even under heavy load

- System Integration: Leading cross functional engineering teams to design, build, and deploy a cohesive system. Integrate independent capabilities into existing solutions

- Customer Collaboration: Working closely with end-users and customers, who are typically military or Government operators, to understand their requirements and translate them into software features. You are experienced in product discovery best practices

- Knowledge of performance-focused tools and techniques for rendering large datasets and building responsive, smooth interfaces

- A demonstrated ability to adopt new languages, libraries, and technologies

- Organized, detail-oriented, and with an ability to work both independently and collaboratively

- Demonstrated experience as an effective communicator to both technical and non-technical audiences

postings.title: Lead Model-Based Systems Engineer
postings.description:
STR is hiring a Lead Model-Based Systems Engineer (MBSE) in our Arlington, VA office to work across a broad portfolio of DoD mission areas. The Systems Engineer should have experience architecting systems, working across the Systems Engineering Lifecycle, a deep understanding of Systems Engineering principles, reverse engineering techniques, and the ability to work with complex software systems and the utilization of Digital Engineering/MBSE to accomplish program goals. The candidate will support STR’s Systems Development Division to achieve architectural integrity and traceability from requirements analysis through system and software development and production system deployment.

This position offers the opportunity to work with leading domain experts developing solutions to solve the most challenging national security problems. Our teams consist of motivated individuals with degrees in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics, and data science. The ideal candidate will be experienced in Systems Engineering processes and techniques, Modeling and Simulation, software-based systems, Digital Engineering/MBSE and be excited about opportunities to grow and be a source of subject matter expertise across the organization.

The Systems Engineer should have experience implementing a rigorous MBSE approach to develop DoD systems. New programs at STR will be looking to adopt agile approaches that incorporate model-based requirements management and traceability with software development. This position is well suited for a Systems Engineer with a software systems background who is interested in improving the state of the practice and demonstrating the advantages that MBSE can offer.

What you will do:

- Utilize your Systems Engineering skillset as part of a tightly knit team to design, develop, implement, and deploy advanced software systems

- Analyze, reverse-engineer, derive, and define requirements from ambiguous or incomplete software system implementations and codebases

- Develop/generate documentation (e.g. Systems Requirements Document, SysML models) to capture requirements of new and existing systems

- Perform gap analysis between derived requirements and current system capabilities to identify missing features or functionalities

- Assist other technical contributors throughout the software lifecycle, from early prototypes to fully integrated systems

- Implement MBSE approaches using SysML in Cameo

- Work closely with domain experts and software development teams to realize program designs for a diverse set of applications, including:

- Distributed mission planning

- Intelligence Surveillance Reconnaissance (ISR) management

- Decision making support to human analysts/planners

- This position is based in one of our offices but will take advantage of STR’s flexible, hybrid environment: we anticipate that you could work remotely as much as 25% of the time

- Any time work does not require use of STR’s facilities, you are welcome to work remotely

Who you are:

- This position requires an Active DoD Top Secret Clearance with SCI eligibility, for which U.S. citizenship is needed by U.S. Government

- BS, MS or PhD in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field

- Experience implementing open architectures and integrating with large scale software-intensive systems and platform systems

- Strong ability to derive requirements from existing software and capture new customer requirements, and translate those into development tasks for software teams

- Comfortable working in dynamic environments and adjusting to changing priorities

- Minimum of 8 years work experience as a Systems Engineer or related field

- Minimum of 3 years experience architecting systems using system modeling tools (SysML in Cameo)

Even Better:

- Domain expertise or familiarity with one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:

- Sea, air, and space platforms, mission planning, and C2 systems

- Sensor Resource Management

- Electronic Warfare

- Software deployment in cloud-based systems

- Government Open System Architectures (UCI, OMS, COARPS)

- 5+ years of experience in architecting systems using system modeling tools (SysML in Cameo)

- Experience porting models/designs from SparxEA to Cameo

- Experience in Java, Python, or object-oriented programming languages

- Agile software development experience and/or certification

Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $157,000 - $224,000

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

The Sensors Division develops advanced solutions in radar, space-based sensing, electronic warfare, and underwater acoustics. In this position, you will design, implement, and operate integrated simulation testbeds for advanced space and defense systems. Your work will include analyzing integrated system performance, developing and executing test plans, and defining system evaluation criteria. You will work closely with both research and software teams to integrate simulation and analysis tools and collaborate with customers to understand key challenges and needs.

What you will do: 

- Design and apply cutting-edge models and simulation frameworks to support test and evaluation of algorithms, command & control systems, and deployed software solutions

- Interact closely with customers to understand needs & requirements and to communicate technical results

- Experience with space defense programs and modeling, sensor systems, platforms, and ground systems

- RF/radar signal processing, optimization, waveform design, electronic warfare, machine learning, adaptive signal processing, AI/ML approaches to optimization, model & simulation, systems engineering, test engineering, radar modelling, optics modelling, orbital mechanics, space systems (propulsion, thermal, communications, GNC)

postings.title: Lead Network Systems Researcher
postings.description:
About the Team

STR’s Intelligence Division researches, develops, and transitions advanced analytics and machine-learning solutions for challenging national-security problems. Our team includes engineers and researchers with advanced backgrounds in engineering, computer science, mathematics, and data science who apply deep technical expertise and creativity to mission-critical challenges.

Our work spans data analysis, deep learning, and statistical methods across networking, communications, social media, text, time series, geospatial, and imagery data. We develop capabilities under constraints not typically encountered in commercial environments. U.S. Government analysts use our tools and technologies to extract, enrich, and act on intelligence information worldwide.

The Role

As a Lead Network Systems Researcher, you will lead the technical execution of advanced networking, communications, and ML-enabled systems. You will apply state-of-the-art machine-learning methods, networking expertise, and systems-engineering skills to challenges involving disparate and unlabeled data sources, real-time data communications, and networked systems.

You will work with software engineers, systems engineers, algorithm developers, researchers, and academic collaborators to develop, integrate, test, and transition mission-relevant capabilities. You will guide project technical direction, translate customer needs into executable plans, and ensure delivered systems meet high standards for quality, performance, maintainability, testability, reuse, and security.

What You Will Do:

- Lead project execution: Lead technical execution of networking, communications, and ML-enabled systems projects from requirements definition through development, integration, test, demonstration, and transition

- Translate mission needs into plans: Convert customer needs and mission objectives into system requirements, technical architectures, development and test plans, milestones, performance metrics, and acceptance criteria

- Lead the technical team: Lead and mentor multidisciplinary teams of software engineers, systems engineers, researchers, and algorithm developers

- Manage technical work: Decompose technical problems into actionable tasks; assign work, manage dependencies and risks, and track execution against program objectives

- Own project architecture: Design and oversee implementation of architectures spanning network protocols, data pipelines, ML models, edge and network-core compute, and external interfaces

- Drive integration and quality: Lead design reviews, code reviews, integration activities, technical demonstrations, and customer engagements; ensure delivered systems meet quality, performance, maintainability, testability, security, and reuse standards

- Apply advanced methods: Apply state-of-the-art ML and statistical methods to networking, communications, and real-time data challenges in collaboration with customers, mission partners, academic collaborators, and industry partners

Who You Are:

- Education and experience: PhD with 2+ years, MS with 6+ years, or BS with 8+ years of relevant experience in computer science, machine learning, computer/electrical engineering, or a related technical discipline

- Clearance eligibility: Ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret security clearance for which U.S Citizenship is needed by the U.S government

- Technical delivery leadership: Experience leading technical development efforts or major workstreams involving software, systems, networking, communications, machine learning, or related domains

- Systems engineering: Experience translating customer or mission needs into technical requirements, system designs, development and test plans, and integrated software and/or hardware systems

- ML expertise: Experience applying state-of-the-art ML methods, including unsupervised and semi-supervised learning techniques, to real-world problems across resource-constrained edge and resource-rich network-core environments

- Networking expertise: Strong understanding of networking and communications theory across the OSI model

- Engineering and communication practices: Working knowledge of software design patterns and engineering best practices, including integration, testing, version control, and collaboration tools such as Git, JIRA, and Confluence; strong written and verbal communication skills

Even Better:

- Clearance: Active Top Secret security clearance

- Collaborative software development: Experience developing software in large, multi-party code bases using collaborative engineering practices and modern developer tools, including LLM-enabled coding tools such as Cursor or Codex.

- Protocol-layer development: Experience developing, integrating, testing, or evaluating software at the PHY, MAC, Network, or Application layers

- Communications domain expertise: Experience with 5G system development, testing, evaluation, network management, network security, and/or protocol analysis

- Customer and capture support: Experience supporting technical proposals, customer demonstrations, or capture activities with DoW or IC customers

postings.title: Lead Network Systems Researcher
postings.description:
About the Team

STR’s Intelligence Division researches, develops, and transitions advanced analytics and machine-learning solutions for challenging national-security problems. Our team includes engineers and researchers with advanced backgrounds in engineering, computer science, mathematics, and data science who apply deep technical expertise and creativity to mission-critical challenges.

Our work spans data analysis, deep learning, and statistical methods across networking, communications, social media, text, time series, geospatial, and imagery data. We develop capabilities under constraints not typically encountered in commercial environments. U.S. Government analysts use our tools and technologies to extract, enrich, and act on intelligence information worldwide.

The Role

As a Lead Network Systems Researcher, you will lead the technical execution of advanced networking, communications, and ML-enabled systems. You will apply state-of-the-art machine-learning methods, networking expertise, and systems-engineering skills to challenges involving disparate and unlabeled data sources, real-time data communications, and networked systems.

You will work with software engineers, systems engineers, algorithm developers, researchers, and academic collaborators to develop, integrate, test, and transition mission-relevant capabilities. You will guide project technical direction, translate customer needs into executable plans, and ensure delivered systems meet high standards for quality, performance, maintainability, testability, reuse, and security.

What You Will Do:

- Lead project execution: Lead technical execution of networking, communications, and ML-enabled systems projects from requirements definition through development, integration, test, demonstration, and transition

- Translate mission needs into plans: Convert customer needs and mission objectives into system requirements, technical architectures, development and test plans, milestones, performance metrics, and acceptance criteria

- Lead the technical team: Lead and mentor multidisciplinary teams of software engineers, systems engineers, researchers, and algorithm developers

- Manage technical work: Decompose technical problems into actionable tasks; assign work, manage dependencies and risks, and track execution against program objectives

- Own project architecture: Design and oversee implementation of architectures spanning network protocols, data pipelines, ML models, edge and network-core compute, and external interfaces

- Drive integration and quality: Lead design reviews, code reviews, integration activities, technical demonstrations, and customer engagements; ensure delivered systems meet quality, performance, maintainability, testability, security, and reuse standards

- Apply advanced methods: Apply state-of-the-art ML and statistical methods to networking, communications, and real-time data challenges in collaboration with customers, mission partners, academic collaborators, and industry partners

Who You Are:

- Education and experience: PhD with 2+ years, MS with 6+ years, or BS with 8+ years of relevant experience in computer science, machine learning, computer/electrical engineering, or a related technical discipline

- Clearance eligibility: Ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret security clearance for which U.S Citizenship is needed by the U.S government

- Technical delivery leadership: Experience leading technical development efforts or major workstreams involving software, systems, networking, communications, machine learning, or related domains

- Systems engineering: Experience translating customer or mission needs into technical requirements, system designs, development and test plans, and integrated software and/or hardware systems

- ML expertise: Experience applying state-of-the-art ML methods, including unsupervised and semi-supervised learning techniques, to real-world problems across resource-constrained edge and resource-rich network-core environments

- Networking expertise: Strong understanding of networking and communications theory across the OSI model

- Engineering and communication practices: Working knowledge of software design patterns and engineering best practices, including integration, testing, version control, and collaboration tools such as Git, JIRA, and Confluence; strong written and verbal communication skills

Even Better:

- Clearance: Active Top Secret security clearance

- Collaborative software development: Experience developing software in large, multi-party code bases using collaborative engineering practices and modern developer tools, including LLM-enabled coding tools such as Cursor or Codex.

- Protocol-layer development: Experience developing, integrating, testing, or evaluating software at the PHY, MAC, Network, or Application layers

- Communications domain expertise: Experience with 5G system development, testing, evaluation, network management, network security, and/or protocol analysis

- Customer and capture support: Experience supporting technical proposals, customer demonstrations, or capture activities with DoW or IC customers

postings.title: Lead Open Software Systems Engineer
postings.description:
About the Team:

The Sensors Division at STR focuses on technology development for advanced sensor systems, particularly in the areas of airborne/surface-based radar, electronic warfare, underwater acoustics, hyperspectral imaging, and EO/IR sensing. Within this role, we perform work on full system prototypes, experiment campaigns and technology component development. Development roles within the Sensors Division include RF analog/digital hardware, acoustic hardware, signal processing algorithms, machine learning algorithms, tracking/fusion, as well as real-time embedded processor implementation.

Within the Sensors Division, the Real-time Architectures, Integration and Demonstration (RAID) Group focuses on transition of algorithms from concept to real-time software, providing open architecture expertise, and facilitating integration of capabilities for experimentation, test, and deployment.

The RAID Group is seeking a Lead Systems Engineer with demonstrated expertise in Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) to help design, develop, implement, test, and maintain real-time software that controls complex hardware systems while complying with open architecture standards. You will work as part of focused teams to transition software products from internally developed and integrated software into production-quality software that can be transitioned to outside integrators for use on their embedded and distributed computing platforms. You will be responsible for developing best practices and automated processes in coordination with software and system engineers to further integrate MBSE into Agile Software development processes.

A successful candidate will have experience working on teams that have developed large scale high-performance C/C++ software for sensor systems. Strong understanding of MBSE practices and how they are compatible with real-time systems developed via an Agile process is essential. Experience with open architecture frameworks and standards is highly desired. Strong technical, interpersonal, and communication skills are important for working in collaborative, multi-disciplinary teams.

What you will do:

- Collaborate with principal investigators, software engineers, and other system engineers to plan, model, develop, test, and document large scale software/hardware systems

- Collaborate with software and system engineers to integrate MBSE artifacts with software development pipelines (code / test generation, large scale code analysis, etc.)

- Collaborate with software and system engineers to integrate MBSE processes to streamline software development

- Perform requirement extraction, management, and analysis for RF sensor signal processing or equivalent systems

- Document (and/or support documentation of) system designs, software designs, APIs, implementation details, and technical reports

- Perform peer reviews and suggest next steps for technical work

- Support approximately 5% travel for integration events, customer meetings, and field demonstrations

Who you are:

- Ability to obtain and retain a Secret or Top Secret Security Clearance, for which U.S citizenship is needed by the U.S government

- PhD + 2 years, MS + 5 years, or BS + 7 years in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field

- Experience with Model Based Systems Engineering for medium to large scale agile software development programs

- Strong proficiency with CAMEO or other Model Base Systems Engineering tools

- Experience working with professional software development teams

- Excellent technical writing and communication skills

Even Better:

- Active Security Clearance at the Secret or Top Secret level (strongly preferred due to clearance processing time)

- Experience developing products / toolkits that are integrated by 3rd parties with various hardware and software subsystems

- Proficiency in automated integration of CAMEO or other Model Based Systems engineering tools with Agile development processes

- Experience working with signal processing development teams

- Experience with open architecture standards and frameworks

- Experience with version control systems (Git) and collaborative development practices

- Experience with CAMEO plugin development

- Understanding of RF sensor system concepts

- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps and integrating MBSE to those systems

- Prior contributions to proposal development and technical writing

Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $174,000.00 - $225,000.00

postings.title: Lead Product Engineer
postings.description:
Lead Product Engineer 

About the Team 

The Mission Applications (MA) Group within the AC2 Division creates outsized mission impact with our customers through specialized application and deployment of STR technology. Staff within the MA group have a deep understanding of missions and technology needs for national security with skills targeting transition of technology to operational use, including product management, UX Product implementation, software integration & mission engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, and program management. MA staff combine with other science and engineering staff from the various STR research and development groups to form dedicated product teams focused on accelerating the operational transition of cutting-edge software technologies. 

The Role: 

 As a Lead Product Engineer in the MA Group, you are the technical professional who bridges the gap between a conceptual idea from the Product team and an operational mission application through the oversight of the entire lifecycle of a product. You are responsible for design, test, and product refinement to ensure they meet strict standards for performance, reliability, and cost. By collaborating closely with Product, Platform, Mission Engineers and system architects, product engineers troubleshoot design flaws early, optimize production efficiency, and align technical choices with the needs of the end user. 

What You Will Do: 

- Own software solutions that will solve operational problems, today 

- Build and test features within production software with a bias towards simplicity, workflow supportability, reliability, durability, and user experience 

- Bridge the gap between concept and production, choosing efficient approaches to rapidly build upon the initial prototype while scaling processes 

- Triage issues, identify root cause failures, drive resolution to improve user outcomes 

- Partner with the product team and end users to turn customer needs into features while balancing user experience with engineering constraints 

- Foster team collaboration to embrace the give and take between software functionality, user experience, and enabling technology 

- Hold high-integrity commitments to deliver viable solutions on timelines that work for the customer and business 

- Work in a fast-paced environment to enable successful contract execution 

This role will take advantage of STR’s flexible, hybrid environment – when the work does not require use of STR’s facilities, you are welcome to work remotely.  

Who You Are: 

- Must be a U.S. citizen 

- BS in Computer Science or related technical field with at least 5 years of work experience 

- Experience building high-quality production software features 

- A passion for crafting user-centric interfaces and a keen eye for design details 

- Demonstrated strong proficiency in modern technologies such as React, TypeScript, and Python 

- Knowledge of performance-focused tools and techniques for rendering large datasets and building responsive, smooth interfaces 

- A demonstrated ability to adopt new languages, libraries, and technologies 

- Organized, detail-oriented, and with an ability to work both independently and collaboratively 

- Demonstrated experience as an effective communicator to both technical and non-technical audiences 

- Aptitude for collaborating with stakeholders across a wide range of technical comfort levels 

Even Better: 

- Active Security Clearance 

- Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related technical field 

- Experience building production or enterprise scale applications 

- Experience working with visual design tools to communicate ideas 

- Fluency with software development best practices and use of AI tools 

- Located near STR office in Carlsbad, CA, Arlington, VA, Woburn, MA, Denver, CO or Honolulu, HI.

postings.title: Lead Program Manager
postings.description:
About the Team

The Sensors Division within STR focuses on the development and analysis of advanced sensor systems in the RF, acoustic, and electro-optical domains. This includes the design and development of novel sensors and advanced information processing techniques from ideation to prototype implementations. The Subsea and Seabed Systems (SSS) Group develops and delivers advanced undersea sensor and signal processing systems related to intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) and counter-ISR applications.

The Role

The SSS Group is seeking a Lead Program Manager with a highly technical, undersea warfare background to manage a portfolio of programs focused on future undersea systems. This portfolio spans concept generation and prototype development with the goal that programs will continue into low-rate initial production (LRIP) or production. As such, we are looking for applicants with experience traversing that span of technology readiness and an ability to adaptively scale process. In this role you will lead small, highly capable, multidisciplinary teams of researchers, scientists, and engineers across STR campuses, coordinating electrical and mechanical design, software development, system construction, integration, testing, and field execution to meet cost, schedule, and performance objectives on innovative, complex, and challenging national security programs.

A central responsibility is the financial planning and execution of fast-paced, complex programs: developing credible budgets and resource plans, maintaining current forecasts, and making timely cost, schedule, and staffing decisions as technical priorities evolve. Your areas of specific focus will also include building and executing programmatic baselines, including personnel, deliverables, and subcontractor/contract manufacturer management plans while anticipating risks, resolving resource, security, and contracting challenges, and meeting or managing customer, sponsor, and leadership expectations.

A successful candidate will have recent and significant program manager experience building fieldable systems and a working knowledge in several of the following areas: undersea warfare, sonar systems, ocean engineering, modeling and simulation, test and evaluation, hardware design, software architecture, uncrewed underwater vehicles, resource management, signal processing, and/or communications. This position requires competency in leading and managing multidisciplinary teams, briefing senior leadership, cultivating positive, collaborative, and productive work environments, and a strong proficiency in all aspects of program management. Strong interpersonal, communication, mentorship, and peer-leadership skills are also required.

What you will do:

- Execute multiple fast-paced, complex programs against cost, schedule, and technical objectives, with accountability for financial planning and performance

- Develop and maintain program budgets, time-phased spending plans, staffing and resource allocations, and estimates to complete and at completion across labor, materials, travel, subcontractors, and contract manufacturers

- Manage financial execution by reviewing actual costs and commitments, monitoring burn rates and funding availability, analyzing variances, and updating forecasts as program needs change

- Work with technical leads, finance, and contracts to assess cost and schedule tradeoffs, implement corrective actions, and communicate financial risks and resource needs to leadership and sponsors

- Lead proposals by providing expertise in proposal development while ensuring adherence to a gated capture process

- Create subcontractor statements of work and managing and tracking subcontractors to ensure proper execution

- Work with contract manufacturers to build up to LRIP and then meet LRIP milestones with high quality

- Lead multidisciplinary teams through design, build, integration, test readiness, and field execution, coordinating interdependent engineering activities to deliver fieldable systems

- Oversee preparation, planning, and execution of advanced undersea system testing, including test objectives, personnel and resource coordination, readiness activities, at-sea execution, and post-test assessment

- Provide regular program briefs to group and division leadership.

- Create and maintain an environment that fosters collaboration by giving clear direction and constructive feedback to the team

- Monitor progress against goals, anticipating risks, resolving issues, and initiating corrective actions as appropriate

Who you are:

- Active Clearance, current TS/SSBI with SCI preferred; ability to gain and keep SCI/SAP accreditations required, for which U.S citizenship is needed by the U.S government

- Technical degree and 8+ years of prior relevant experience in government contracting, research and development (R&D), or advanced technology production. Equivalent experience will be considered

- Program manager or control account manager experience in a design and development and/or build contract, including work breakdown structure (WBS) definition, schedule generation, financial analysis and reporting, and resource management

- Demonstrated experience planning and executing the finances of fast-paced, complex programs, including budget development, resource planning, financial forecasting, cost and variance analysis, and timely corrective action to meet program objectives within available funding

- Experience in proposal management, including planning and cost estimation

- Experience managing projects larger than $10M for the Department of War

- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills

- Experience leading small, highly capable, multidisciplinary teams executing complex advanced-technology programs spanning electrical and mechanical design, software development, system construction, integration, test, and field execution

- Demonstrated ability to coordinate interdependent engineering disciplines and drive systems from design and build through integration, readiness, and successful execution in operationally relevant environments

- Strong presentation and organizational skills

Desired Qualifications

- Experience with advanced undersea warfare system concepts, signal processing, underwater acoustics, and ocean engineering

- Experience with sonar systems

- Experience preparing, planning, and executing testing and fielding of advanced undersea systems and vehicles, including development of test objectives, coordination of personnel and resources, test readiness activities, at-sea execution, and post-test assessment.

- Experience conducting operationally representative testing of advanced undersea systems in realistic maritime environments, working with operators, engineers, and government sponsors to translate mission needs and operating conditions into test scenarios and performance measures, and using results to inform system design, performance improvements, operational employment, and transition toward fieldable capability

- Work experience in government, FFRDC, or defense industry companies and sponsors

- Earned value management system (EVMS) experience

- Contract manufacturing experience

- Risk and opportunity management experience

- Experience managing research and development programs

- Proficiency in all Microsoft Office applications, including but not limited to Microsoft Project, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

Why Join Us

postings.description:
About the Team

The Sensors Division at STR focuses on technology development for advanced sensor systems and platforms in support of national security requirements. Our particular focus areas include airborne/spaceborne/surface-based radar, electronic warfare, underwater acoustics, hyperspectral imaging, and EO/IR sensing. To support these missions, the Division’s efforts span multiple technical areas, including RF analog/digital hardware, acoustic hardware, signal processing algorithms, machine learning algorithms, systems analysis, and real-time embedded processor implementation.

The Algorithms, Processing and Experimentation (APEX) Group specializes in development of RF/radar modes, skills and applications, with particular emphasis on advanced signal processing chains and associated algorithm research. We mature these technologies with the objective of implementation, integration, and eventual utility in RF-based systems, typically tailoring our work for highly specific Defense (e.g., Air Force, Space Force, Navy, DARPA, etc.) and Intelligence Community needs.

About the Role

The APEX Group is seeking a Lead Radar Tracking Algorithm Developer to develop advanced tracking algorithms for radar and RF applications utilizing concepts from tracking algorithms, radar signal processing, multi-static radar, and resource management. 

A successful candidate will have working knowledge in several of the following areas: multi-hypothesis trackers, estimation theory, adaptive signal processing, radar systems, and resource management. This position requires skills working as part of and leading multi-disciplinary teams designing and analyzing tracking algorithms for complex systems. Strong technical, interpersonal, communication, and technical leadership skills are desired.

Who you are:

- Active Security Clearance at the Secret level and the ability to obtain Top-Secret Clearance, for which U.S citizenship is needed by the U.S government

- Experience developing, testing, and evaluating advanced tracking algorithms

- Experience with radar and/or RF systems

- Strong mathematical, troubleshooting, written, and verbal communication skills

- Proficiency in MATLAB and/or Python as well as other higher-level languages

- Strong presentation and organizational skills

Even Better:

- Active Top-Secret security clearance

- Experience with multiple hypothesis trackers (MHTs), particle filters, and other advanced tracking algorithms

- Develop a deep technical understanding of a third-party radar system, including RF architecture, signal chains, modes, interfaces, and operational constraints

- Define and own the RF systems integration approach for implementing a new mode on an externally developed radar

- Translate system-level objectives into clear RF, interface, and integration requirements

- Design and validate integration strategies, including RF interfaces, timing, control, and signal processing impacts

- Collaborate closely with the external radar developer to resolve RF, system, and integration challenges Lead integration test planning, execution, and analysis, including defining success criteria and validation methods Identify risks and tradeoffs related to RF performance, integration complexity, and system compatibility

- Serve as the technical lead and escalation point for RF systems integration issues Communicate findings and recommendations to internal leadership and cross-organizational stakeholders

- PhD, MS, or BS in Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or related technical discipline 

- BS with 8+ years, MS with 6+ years or PhD with 2+ years of relevant experience

- Relevant experience designing, integrating and testing RF sensor and/or communication systems

- Familiarity with RF component technology and performance characteristics

- Strong scientific programming skills including Matlab, Python, Simulink and/or C/C++

- Ability to translate customer requirements to determine research focus

The Sensors Division at STR focuses on technology development for advanced sensor systems and platforms in support of national security requirements. Our particular focus areas include airborne/spaceborne/surface-based radar, electronic warfare, underwater acoustics, hyperspectral imaging, and EO/IR sensing. To support these missions, the Division’s efforts span multiple technical areas, including RF analog/digital hardware, acoustic hardware, signal processing algorithms, machine learning algorithms, systems analysis, and real-time embedded processor implementation.

The Algorithms, Processing and Experimentation (APEX) Group specializes in development of RF/radar modes, skills and applications, with particular emphasis on advanced signal processing chains and associated algorithm research. We mature these technologies with the objective of implementation, integration, and eventual utility in RF-based systems, typically tailoring our work for highly specific Defense (e.g., Air Force, Space Force, Navy, DARPA, etc.) and Intelligence Community needs.

The Role:

We are seeking an experienced RF Systems Integration Engineer to lead RF test, measurement, and system integration activities in support of integrating a new operational mode onto an externally developed radar system. This role requires deep hands-on expertise in RF and radar systems, combined with the ability to understand, influence, and integrate with a complex radar platform owned and developed by another organization. You will serve as the technical authority for RF systems integration owning the end-to-end understanding of the radar, defining integration requirements, leading RF characterization and testing, and designing the technical approach required to successfully implement and validate our mode on the partner radar system.

What you will do: 

- Lead RF testing, measurement, and characterization efforts across lab, integration, and system-level environments

- Develop a deep technical understanding of a third-party radar system, including RF architecture, signal chains, modes, interfaces, and operational constraints

- Define and own the RF systems integration approach for implementing a new mode on an externally developed radar

- Translate system-level objectives into clear RF, interface, and integration requirements

- Design and validate integration strategies, including RF interfaces, timing, control, and signal processing impacts

- Collaborate closely with the external radar developer to resolve RF, system, and integration challenges Lead integration test planning, execution, and analysis, including defining success criteria and validation methods Identify risks and tradeoffs related to RF performance, integration complexity, and system compatibility

- Serve as the technical lead and escalation point for RF systems integration issues Communicate findings and recommendations to internal leadership and cross-organizational stakeholders

Who you are:

- Active Security Clearance, with eligibility to support special access programs, for which U.S Citizenship is required by the U.S government 

- PhD, MS, or BS in Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or related technical discipline 

- BS with 8+ years, MS with 6+ years, or PhD with 2+ years of relevant experience

- Relevant experience designing, integrating and testing RF sensor and/or communication systems

- Familiarity with RF component technology and performance characteristics

- Strong scientific programming skills including Matlab, Python, Simulink and/or C/C++

- Ability to translate customer requirements to determine research focus

- Strong communication skills and the ability to describe complex technical concepts to fellow researchers as well as to non-technical people

- Deep expertise in RF systems, radar systems, and RF test & measurement Strong understanding of radar architectures, waveforms, modes, and RF signal chains

Even Better:

- Current TS/SSBI with SCI and ability to gain and hold SCI/SAP accreditations

- Prior experience with advanced development efforts in DoD programs

- Prior experience integrating new functionality or modes into existing or third-party radar systems

- Broad experience across multiple defense-related RF domain programs (e.g., Communications, Electronic Warfare, Radar, etc.) 

Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $160,000 - $220,000

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

STR is a growing technology company with locations near Boston, MA, Arlington, VA, near Dayton, OH, Melbourne, FL, Carlsbad, CA, Atlanta, GA, and Denver, CO. We specialize in advanced research and development for defense, intelligence, and national security in: cyber; next generation sensors, radar, sonar, communications, and electronic warfare; and artificial intelligence algorithms and analytics to make sense of the complexity that is exploding around us.

STR is committed to creating a collaborative learning environment that supports deep technical understanding and recognizes the contributions and achievements of all team members. Our work is challenging, and we go home at night knowing that we pushed the envelope of technology and made the world safer.

STR is not just any company. Our people, culture, and attitude along with their unique set of skills, experiences, and perspectives put us on a trajectory to change the world. We can't do it alone, though - we need fellow trailblazers. If you are one, join our team and help to keep our society safe! Visit us at www.str.us for more info.

STR is an equal opportunity employer. We are fully dedicated to hiring the most qualified candidate regardless of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation and pregnancy), marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any portion of the employment process, email us at appassist@str.us and provide your contact info.

Pursuant to applicable federal law and regulations, positions at STR require employees to obtain national security clearances and satisfy the requirements for compliance with export control and other applicable laws.

- Direct Modeling and Simulation activities of advanced RF systems in support of algorithm development, test, and integration

- Plan and support algorithm test and evaluation activities, including performance assessment in laboratory and field environments

- Clearly communicate with customers, stakeholders, sponsors, prime- and subcontractors

- Active Security Clearance, with eligibility to support special access programs, for which US Citizenship is required by the US government

- PhD, MS, or BS in Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or related technical discipline with 3-8+ years of relevant experience depending on degree

- Strong scientific programming skills including Matlab, Python, Simulink and/or C/C++

- Strong communication skills and the ability to describe complex technical concepts to fellow researchers as well as to non-technical people

- Ability to translate customer requirements to determine research focus

- Ability to create and present deep technical briefings as well as high-level briefings to Customers and senior management

- Experience with designing, implementing, testing, and analyzing ML/AI algorithms

- Strong understanding of radar architectures, waveforms, modes, and RF signal chains

Even Better:

- Current TS/SSBI with SCI and ability to gain and hold SCI/SAP accreditations

- Experience with advanced RF system concepts, signal processing, open architectures, and systems integration

- Experience in Software Development

- Ability to survey literature to determine state-of-the-art, incorporate recent research, and transition it into integrated, tested solutions

- Understanding and experience interacting with decision-makers and customers to translate mission needs into an end-to-end, integrated analytical solution

postings.title: Lead Software Engineer
postings.description:
Are you driven to build cutting edge solutions for the nation’s technology needs?

At STR, we’re developing advanced capabilities that create a lasting impact on national security, gaining an edge on the unseen adversary through technology dominance.

About the Team:
STR’s Intelligence Division researches and develops advanced analytics and software solutions to solve challenging problems relevant to national security. Our team specializes in applying cutting-edge machine learning and computer vision in areas such as biometrics, target recognition and autonomous agents to solve national security and intelligence problems. We tackle complex technical challenges under stringent operational constraints by leveraging diverse skill sets from fields such as engineering, computer science, and applied machine learning.

Our projects focus on a wide range of data modalities—including biometric data, video imagery, geospatial, and radio-frequency data—powered by the latest advances in deep learning and statistical techniques. Our solutions have real-world impact, allowing U.S. Government analysts and operators to extract and enrich intelligence information across the globe. If you’re motivated by making a difference while working in a collaborative and fast-paced environment and have experience with systems integration, robust application development, and messaging pipelines, we’d like to hear from you.

The Role:
As a Lead Software Engineer, you will use your software development expertise to operationalize advanced algorithms across a broad range of computer vision programs. You will integrate Python-based machine learning pipelines with complex systems and ensure they are resilient, maintainable, and user-focused.

Collaborating closely with project leads and customers, you will:

- Translate stakeholder requirements into system features and components in a deployable AI/ML solutions stack

- Develop new user-facing features and implement robust backend architectures to support them.

- Build, maintain, and test messaging systems, such as real-time data workflows and distributed processing pipelines.

- Optimize software for data ingestion, transformation, and intelligent storage/retrieval pipelines.

- Maintain and improve workflows for distributed systems, ensuring reliability and performance testing in operational environments.

- Participate in cross-program collaboration, adapting to diverse projects and tools.

Our work involves projects of national significance, and the ability to work on-site in one of our Dayton, OH, Woburn, MA, or Arlington, VA locations (depending on candidate preference) will be required.

postings.description:
About the Team

STR’s Intelligence Division researches, develops, and transitions advanced analytics and machine-learning solutions for challenging national-security problems. Our team includes engineers and researchers with advanced backgrounds in engineering, computer science, mathematics, and data science who apply deep technical expertise and creativity to mission-critical challenges.

Our work spans data analysis, deep learning, and statistical methods across networking, communications, social media, text, time series, geospatial, and imagery data. We develop capabilities under constraints not typically encountered in commercial environments. U.S. Government analysts use our tools and technologies to extract, enrich, and act on intelligence information worldwide.

The Role

As a Lead Software Engineer, you will lead the technical execution of mission-relevant software systems that operationalize advanced analytics, machine learning, and data-processing capabilities. You will apply software and systems engineering expertise to develop scalable, secure, maintainable applications that operate in complex customer environments.

You will work with software engineers, systems engineers, researchers, and mission partners to translate customer needs into executable technical plans. - Own project architecture: Design and oversee architectures spanning services, APIs, data pipelines, databases, ML integrations, user interfaces, and deployment infrastructure

- Drive integration and quality: Lead design reviews, code reviews, integration activities, testing, customer demonstrations, and release readiness; ensure reliability, security, maintainability, and performance

- Support growth and transition: Contribute technical content to proposals, customer engagements, and transition planning while ensuring delivered capabilities are reusable and mission relevant

- Technical delivery leadership: Experience leading software development efforts or major workstreams involving applications, services, distributed systems, data platforms, or related domains

- Systems engineering: Experience translating customer needs into software requirements, designs, development plans, test plans, and integrated capabilities

- Software development: Proficiency in one or more programming languages, such as Python, C++, Java, Go, or similar languages, with experience developing and maintaining production-quality software

- Engineering practices: Experience with Git, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, issue tracking, documentation, and secure software-development practices

- Communication and collaboration: Ability to lead technical discussions, communicate risks and tradeoffs, and work effectively with customers and multidisciplinary teams

Even Better

- Clearance: Active Secret, Top Secret, or TS/SCI security clearance

- Architecture experience: Experience designing system or software architectures for distributed, data-intensive, real-time, cloud, on-premises, or edge systems

- DevSecOps experience: Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure automation, container orchestration, cloud platforms, monitoring, logging, and security tooling

- Large codebase experience: Experience developing software in large, multi-team code bases using collaborative engineering practices

- Decentralized systems: Familiarity with message queues, stream processing, distributed computing, or microservices

- Customer and capture support: Experience supporting technical proposals, customer demonstrations, technical briefings, or capture activities with DoW or IC customers

- Modern development tools: Experience using LLM-enabled development tools, such as Cursor or Codex, in a secure and effective engineering workflow

postings.title: Lead Software Engineer
postings.description:
Lead Software Engineer

The Sensors Division at STR focuses on technology development for advanced sensor systems, particularly in the areas of airborne/surface-based radar, electronic warfare, underwater acoustics, hyperspectral imaging, and EO/IR sensing. Within this role, we perform work on full system prototypes, experiment campaigns and technology component development. Particular development roles within the Sensors Division include RF analog/digital hardware, acoustic hardware, signal processing algorithms, machine learning algorithms, tracking/fusion, as well as real-time embedded processor implementation.

Within the Sensors Division, the Maritime Domain Applications (MDA) Group focuses on development of advanced sensing concepts utilizing adaptive signal processing, resource management, advanced algorithm development, as well as executing advanced sensor concept demonstrations.

The Role:

The MDA Group is seeking a Lead Software Engineer to join a team supporting a critical ongoing national security mission. Our work spans the development of new algorithms and sensing concepts through their implementation in efficient software for real-world systems.

The Lead Software Engineer will work as part of MDA’s team of algorithm developers, sensor domain experts, and software engineers, to maintain and enhance an established operational system. This role will bring proven expertise in C/C++ backend development to help MDA mature and integrate advanced algorithms. At the Lead level in MDA, STR expects strong individual contributions while also mentoring junior engineers and guiding a small team’s development efforts from prototype to release.

A successful candidate will possess 7+ years of practical and domain-relevant experience across the software engineering life cycle and will have delivered high impact enhancements to large scale codebases. They will demonstrate a proven ability to take ownership of technical challenges and deliver results in collaborative, fast-paced environments. The ideal candidate will bring a mastery of software engineering principles, real-world experience in data processing for scientific computing, and an innate desire to deliver impactful updates.

What you will do:

- Work closely with a small, dedicated research team to develop innovative solutions to complex problems

- Support algorithm engineers and scientists to mature advanced algorithms by transforming prototype implementations (Python/MATLAB) into production software (C/C++)

- Maintain and enhance high-quality software for ongoing real world operational users

- Use High-Performance Computing (HPC) Linux environments to build and validate software solutions

- Enhance system quality through software investigations while building domain expertise

- Analyze and improve existing designs and processes to optimize performance

- Take ownership of significant software features and deliver them with minimal supervision

- Lead small multi-disciplinary groups through prototyping to execution and production release

- Mentor junior software engineers and guide software integration efforts across the algorithm team

Who you are:

- U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain a Security Clearance

- BS with 7+ years of experience or MS with 5+ years of experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or related field

- Experience mentoring or leading other developers through product development

- Intellectually curious and self-driven, with a desire to deliver high-impact technical solutions

- Mastery of C and C++ backend programming and design standards (object-oriented, multi-threaded)

- Mastery of source code management (GIT), Linux development environments, and agile processes

- Proficient in MATLAB and/or Python with experience translating to C/C++

- Team player with excellent communication skills, both verbal and written

- Experience in development for scientific computing (mathematics, physics, signal processing)

postings.description:
Sophisticated integrated systems play a critical role in national security efforts, facilitating an understanding of the global situation, strategic planning, and tactical execution. The reliability, accessibility, and sophistication of these systems can determine the outcomes of conflicts before they begin. STR’s Systems Development Division (SDD) focuses on developing advanced technology solutions to provide asymmetric advantages within the information domain. SDD executes the entire lifecycle of the solution, from conceptualization and architecture refinement through implementation and deployment, while leveraging novel technologies to deliver first-of-a-kind systems. Current efforts include programs for airborne and space RF sensors and advanced operations enabled by multi-function, multi-modal capabilities.

As a Lead Software I&T Engineer you will integrate, test, and verify C++ software implementing complex embedded radar systems, with on Air-to-Air applications. Critically, this role is the pathfinder for SDD's SW I&T capability — you will capture lessons learned, establish reusable frameworks and processes, and lay the groundwork for department-level support across SDD's portfolio of programs. 

What you will do:

- Develop and execute plans to integrate software components into processes and ultimately into standalone subsystems

- Develop and execute test procedures and frameworks to verify correct implementation and performance of C++ software

- Develop and evolve program-specific SW I&T plans, capturing lessons learned and reusable patterns that will inform division-wide SW I&T standards

- Develop test frameworks to verify correct implementation and performance of C++ software

- Create automated test scripts and tools to implement and execute integration and test plans

- Maintain a suite of automated integration and requirement verification regression tests suitable for incorporation into a DevSecOps pipeline

- Participate in peer reviews of requirements, architecture, software implementations, and test plans

- Verify interface correctness, including coordination with hardware integration activities.

- Develop analysis tools

- Perform root cause analysis of software defects and implement corrections.

- Document I&T processes, tools, and best practices to support knowledge transfer and process improvement

- Mentor team members and collaborate across programs to identify common I&T needs and solutions

Who you are:

- This position requires the ability to obtain a Top Secret (TS) security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is needed by the U.S. Government.

- Bachelors Degree in Computer Science or related technical field with a minimum 8 years of relevant experience (equivalent experience may be considered)

- Demonstrated expertise in modern C++ and software engineering techniques including multi-threading, memory management, and performance optimization

- Have experience integrating with including unit and system-level testing

- Understand the use of GitLab, CI/CD tools, automated testing frameworks, and code quality tools in software development processes

- Demonstrated effective communication and collaboration skills to work across software, hardware, and systems engineering teams

- Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams, mentor engineers, and influence cross-functional stakeholders. Feel comfortable adapting to new programming languages, third-party software frameworks, and innovative technologies

Nice to Have:

- Hold an active security clearance (Secret minimum, Top Secret preferred)

- Prior experience leading I&T or test engineering teams

- Demonstrate familiarity with signal processing or mathematical modeling

- Experience with GPU software development

- Demonstrate familiarity with integrated systems combining software and hardware to interact with the physical world

- Hold an advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field

- Understand automation frameworks and tools used to streamline repetitive tasks and manage complex workflows

postings.title: Lead Space System Engineer
postings.description:
Lead Space System Engineer

About the Team: The Sensors Division develops advanced solutions in radar, space-based sensing, electronic warfare, and underwater acoustics. Within the Space Missions and Sensing (SMS) Sector, we focus on advancing space sensing, space control, and counter-sensing technologies for critical national security missions.

The Role: Lead Space System Engineer

The SMS Sector is seeking a Lead Space System Engineer to leverage their systems engineering expertise in a dynamic Research & Development environment. In this role, you will be an integral part of a team dedicated to the development of a cutting-edge space-based sensing system platform.

You will architect the system and define requirements for the constellation, encompassing command and control (C2), intersatellite communications, ground processing, spectrum allocation, and satellite sensor modes. You will drive the critical decision-making process on how functionality is partitioned between space and ground segments, balancing mission performance against key constraints such as SWAP-C and security.

As the system engineer, you will collaborate closely with program leadership and external partners to establish and execute the program’s objectives, requirements, and development plan. You will also play a key role in assessing current and future system capabilities and providing technical development insights for business development initiatives. This position offers significant opportunities for career growth within a fast-paced and rapidly expanding company.

What you will do:

- Lead systems engineering and requirements development/management for a team building a space-based sensing platform.

- Architect and drive detailed analysis to derive command and control, data transport, and processing requirements.

- Collaborate with other team leads and subcontractors on the technology roadmap to test and integrate complex subsystems.

- Define mission partitioning between the system under development and other government systems, authoring the Interface Control Documents (ICDs) that govern these critical interactions.

- Provide guidance, coaching, and mentoring to junior staff to elevate the team's overall technical capability.

Who you are:

- Clearance: Active Top Secret (TS) security clearance (U.S. citizenship required).

- BS with 7+ years of experience or MS with 5+ years of experience in Computer Science, Physics, Computer Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or related field. With a proven track record in a System Engineering role.

- Sensing Expertise: Deep technical expertise in one or more of the following:

- Space-based RF/RADAR processing (including signal processing, spectrum allocation, or electronic warfare).

- Space-based Optical sensing and processing (including focal plane arrays, optical trains, or image processing).

- Flight Software: Proven experience with satellite flight software architectures, including real-time software development and hardware-software interface definition.

- Systems Lifecycle: Multi-disciplinary knowledge in mission modeling, systems design, hardware/firmware integration, and testing.

- Leadership: Skilled at directing the activities of development teams and managing technical deliverables.

- Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical requirements into actionable plans.

Even Better:

- Prior experience working on SCI (Sensitive Compartmented Information) or SAP (Special Access Programs).

- Experience designing, integrating, and testing optical communications hardware.

- Experience providing technical contributions to business development and proposal efforts.

- Experience with field test planning and execution.

Pay Information

postings.title: Network Engineer
postings.description:
About the Team

Our Information Technology team at STR is a robust assembly of highly skilled professionals dedicated to ensuring the seamless operation and security of our organization's technological infrastructure. The Enterprise IT group is the backbone of our daily operations, providing comprehensive support and management of our software applications and hardware systems to ensure maximum efficiency and uptime.

Principal Algorithm and Signal Processing Engineer

About the Team: The Sensors Division develops advanced solutions in radar, space-based sensing, electronic warfare, and underwater acoustics. Within the Space Missions and Sensing (SMS) Sector, we focus on advancing space sensing, space control, and counter-sensing technologies for critical national security missions.

The Role: Principal Algorithm and Signal Processing Engineer The SMS Sector is seeking a Principal Algorithm and Signal Processing Engineer to lead the development of state-of-the-art algorithms for the next generation of space systems. In this role, you will bridge the gap between foundational research and mission-ready deployment, developing techniques for EO/IR and RF sensor detection, classification, and autonomous space platform and payload orchestration.

Your work will center on advancing space-based sensing and spacecraft control, leveraging RF, radar, and machine learning to solve complex sensing and resource management challenges. As a technical leader, you will engage directly with customers to translate high-level national security needs into rigorous mathematical frameworks and deployable prototypes. You will lead a team of researchers and collaborate closely with engineering teams to push the boundaries of what is possible in space-based sensing and control.

What you will do:

- Lead the design and application of cutting-edge signal processing and machine learning techniques to solve complex space-based sensing and spacecraft control challenges.

- Engage directly with customers and mission partners to understand unique requirements and shape technical solutions that address critical national security needs.

- Architect autonomous sensor management and processing algorithms that enable real-time processing and autonomy on orbiting platforms.

- Guide multi-disciplinary teams of researchers and engineers, providing the technical vision and mentorship necessary to move from early concept to integration and system verification.

- Drive business development and proposal efforts, identifying new technical opportunities and shaping the future direction of the sector’s research portfolio.

Who you are:

- Clearance: Active Top Secret (TS) security clearance (U.S. citizenship required).

- Education/Experience:

- BS + 7 years, MS + 5 years, or PhD + 3 years of relevant experience in Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical discipline.

- Sensing & Control Expertise: Extensive experience developing sensor system modes and advanced signal/data-processing algorithms. While expertise in Radar is highly valued, we are seeking a broad application of these skills to space systems, including EO/IR space-based sensing and spacecraft control.

- Machine Learning: Proven experience applying Machine Learning (ML) or AI techniques to solve complex signal processing or sensing challenges.

- Technical Leadership: A track record of leading researchers and engineers through the full lifecycle—from analytical derivation through testing and verification of system performance.

- Communication: Excellent communicator and briefer, comfortable translating high-level mission needs into technical requirements for subcontractors, executives, and customers.

- Programming: Proficiency in one or more scientific programming languages, such as MATLAB, Python, or C/C++.

- Prior experience working on SCI (Sensitive Compartmented Information) or SAP (Special Access Programs).

- Deep expertise in Cognitive EW, Electronic Attack, Electronic Protection, or advanced ESM techniques.

- Hands-on experience with ML frameworks and tools such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Ray, or MLflow, specifically applied to image recognition or reinforcement learning.

- Experience interacting with high-level government decision-makers to translate abstract mission needs into end-to-end technical solutions.

- A demonstrated ability to apply novel, interdisciplinary approaches to "impossible" engineering problems.

About the Team:

The Electronic Warfare and Novel Capabilities Group (EWNC) develops and delivers advanced signal processing algorithms and prototype systems for next-generation radar and electronic warfare technologies. 

EWNC fosters a culture of innovation and collaboration. We investigate cutting-edge technologies and collaborate with engineers across STR, academic researchers, and industry partners to develop practical solutions to RF sensing and counter-sensing challenges. Our engineers are empowered to pursue innovative technical ideas, engage directly with customers, lead multidisciplinary teams, and transform advanced research into prototype capabilities that address the nation's most challenging RF sensing and electronic warfare problems. 

The Role: 

We are looking for a Principal Engineer to develop state-of-the-art algorithms for RF sensing, sensor decision-making, and autonomous electronic warfare. Areas of interest include signal detection and classification, electronic support measures, electronic attack, electronic protection, cognitive EW, and advanced RF sensing technologies. You will lead projects and proposal efforts, lead and advise fellow researchers, scientists, and engineers on multi-disciplinary teams spread across multiple STR campuses. You will partner with customers to understand their missions and develop innovative technical approaches, proposal strategies, and program plans that address their current and future needs.

- Lead multidisciplinary technical teams

- Architect advanced RF sensing and EW algorithms from concept to operational prototype

- Engage directly with customers to understand their unique requirements and national security needs, and shape our solutions to meet their objectives 

- Mentor junior researchers and provide technical direction across programs

- Transition new technologies from research into operational prototypes

- Design and apply cutting-edge signal processing to solve complex RF sensing and counter-sensing challenges 

- Support business development initiatives and lead proposal efforts that help shape the future technical direction of our programs and organization

- This position requires the ability to obtain a security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is needed by U.S. Government

- Typically 8-12+ years of relevant experience depending on education and demonstrated expertise

- Demonstrated leadership in radar, EW, RF sensing, or related defense technologies

- Experience on EW or radar programs, including the development of system modes and advanced signal- and data-processing algorithms from mathematical/analytical derivation through testing and verification of system performance

- Expertise in two or more of the following areas:   

- RF sensing and radar signal processing

- Electronic warfare

- Optimization

- Waveform design

- Adaptive signal processing

- AI/ML for RF applications

- Modeling & simulation

- Systems engineering 

- Experience briefing technical work to customers, senior executives, and multidisciplinary audiences
