postings.title: Principal Embedded Software Architect (Top Secret Clearance Required)
postings.description:
Principal Embedded Software Architect

The Systems Development Division (SDD) delivers technology advantage into users’ hands by delivering capabilities focused on end-customer needs that function in operationally relevant environments and timeframes. SDD considers the entire lifecycle of the solution, from conceptualization and architecting, through development, to deployment, while leveraging novel technologies to deliver first-of-a-kind systems. Current efforts include programs for airborne and space RF as well as advanced testing enabled by multi-function, multi-modal capabilities.

STR is seeking a Principal Embedded Software Architect to define and lead the embedded software architecture for advanced RF systems, including software-defined radios, digital receivers/exciters, and radar subsystems built around MPSoC platforms. You will work hands-on in C/C++ and embedded Linux while providing technical leadership across a multidisciplinary team spanning FPGA, RF, digital hardware, and systems engineering.

In this role, you will own the embedded software stack that integrates high-speed data converters, FPGAs, and multi-core processors, with emphasis on data acquisition, streaming, timing, and deterministic control. You will drive system bring-up, integration, and test, ensuring that solutions meet performance, reliability, and maintainability requirements for operationally relevant environments.

What you will do

- Architect and lead development of embedded software for MPSoC-based RF systems (e.g., SDR, digital receivers/exciters, radar subsystems), from requirements through deployment.

- Define hardware/software partitions and interfaces; develop production-quality C/C++ and embedded Linux software (drivers, BSPs, low-level control, and application-level services).

- Bring up new boards and platforms in close collaboration with FPGA, RF, and hardware teams; configure and control high-speed ADCs/DACs, JESD links, and clocking/timing devices.

- Design, implement, and optimize data acquisition and streaming paths between FPGAs and processors, ensuring coherent timing, deterministic latency, and high-throughput operation.

- Lead system-level integration and test, including performance analysis, troubleshooting, and risk mitigation; prepare and maintain architecture documents, ICDs, and technical specifications.

- Provide technical leadership and mentorship to embedded and firmware engineers; lead design reviews, set development standards, and communicate status and technical decisions to stakeholders and customers.

Who you are

- This position requires an Active Top Secret security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is needed by U.S. Government

- BS or Master’s in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field.

- Strong proficiency in embedded C/C++ for real-time, resource-constrained systems, and experience with embedded Linux (drivers, BSPs, kernel-level interfaces).

- Solid understanding of hardware/software interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, GPIO, DMA, memory-mapped registers) and hands-on debugging using tools such as JTAG, logic analyzers, and oscilloscopes.

- Demonstrated experience architecting and integrating complex embedded systems involving MPSoCs/SoCs, FPGAs, and high-speed ADCs/DACs for RF or similar data-intensive applications.

The Systems Development Division (SDD) delivers technology advantage into users’ hands by delivering capabilities focused on end-customer needs that function in operationally relevant environments and timeframes. Current efforts include programs for airborne and space RF as well as advanced testing enabled by multi-function, multi-modal capabilities.

STR is seeking a Principal Embedded Software Architect to define and lead the embedded software architecture for advanced RF systems, including software-defined radios, digital receivers/exciters, and radar subsystems built around MPSoC platforms. You will work hands-on in C/C++ and embedded Linux while providing technical leadership across a multidisciplinary team spanning FPGA, RF, digital hardware, and systems engineering.

In this role, you will own the embedded software stack that integrates high-speed data converters, FPGAs, and multi-core processors, with emphasis on data acquisition, streaming, timing, and deterministic control. - Design, implement, and optimize data acquisition and streaming paths between FPGAs and processors, ensuring coherent timing, deterministic latency, and high-throughput operation.

- Lead system-level integration and test, including performance analysis, troubleshooting, and risk mitigation; prepare and maintain architecture documents, ICDs, and technical specifications.

- Provide technical leadership and mentorship to embedded and firmware engineers; lead design reviews, set development standards, and communicate status and technical decisions to stakeholders and customers.

- Strong proficiency in embedded C/C++ for real-time, resource-constrained systems, and experience with embedded Linux (drivers, BSPs, kernel-level interfaces).

- Experience with AMD/Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC platforms and tools (Vivado, Vitis, PetaLinux).

- Practical experience with digital receiver/exciter systems, SDR, radar, phased arrays, or EW systems; familiarity with JESD204B/C, coherent multichannel timing, and clock distribution.

postings.title: Principal Investigator for Undersea Systems
postings.description:
About the Team:

The Sensors Division within STR focuses on the development and analysis of advanced sensor systems in the RF, acoustic, and electro-optical domains. This includes the design and development of novel sensors and advanced information processing techniques from ideation to prototype implementations. The Subsea and Seabed Systems (SSS) Group develops and delivers advanced undersea sensor and signal processing systems, including bespoke undersea vehicles to deploy those systems. We apply those products to to intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) and counter-ISR applications to deliver missions success to our customers.

The Role:

We are seeking a Principal Investigator (PI) to lead cutting‑edge research and development in advanced undersea sensing and robotic systems. This role is ideal for a technical leader who can originate innovative concepts, shape them into compelling customer‑focused proposals, architect and plan complex programs, and drive execution from initial idea through successful at‑sea demonstration.

You will set the technical vision and lead multidisciplinary teams working on next‑generation Counter‑Uncrewed Underwater Vehicle (C‑UUV) technologies, acoustic underwater sensing and signal processing, noise control, undersea robotics, and other advanced undersea systems. You will engage directly with U.S. Government and industry partners, define new capabilities, and deliver operationally relevant solutions.

What you will do:

Technical Leadership & Vision

- Define and lead a research agenda in advanced undersea sensing and robotics, with emphasis on C‑UUV, acoustic sensing, signal processing, and noise control

- Architect system‑level solutions for uncrewed undersea vehicles, sensor payloads, and command‑and‑control (C2) systems, including sensing, processing, autonomy, and communications

- Provide technical direction to electrical, mechanical, software, and systems engineers; ensure integration of hardware, software, and algorithms into robust undersea systems

- An ideal candidate need not have depth in all areas of a system (electrical, mechanical, software, etc.), but needs to understand their system-level interplay and be able to lead a team across disciplines

Innovation, Capture, and Customer Engagement

- Generate new concepts and technology approaches that address emerging undersea mission needs and capability gaps

- Lead the development of white papers, proposals, and briefings; pitch ideas and technical solutions to U.S. Government and other customers

- Shape program scope, technical objectives, and execution plans in collaboration with business development and program management

- Serve as the primary technical interface to customers, communicating trade‑offs, risks, and progress clearly and credibly

Program Execution & Team Leadership

- Translate concepts into executable technical plans and collaborate with a Program Manager to develop work breakdown structures, schedules, risk management, and resource planning

- Lead technical teams through design, implementation, integration, and test of undersea systems, from lab prototypes to at‑sea demonstrations

- Ensure rigorous system‑level testing (HIL, lab, pool, and at‑sea), and drive iterative improvement based on test data and operational feedback

- Mentor and develop early‑career engineers and researchers; foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and hands‑on problem solving

Technical Execution (Domain Expertise)

- Provide technical expertise in an area of undersea research. This may include:

- Guide the design and integration of advanced acoustic sensing systems, including transducer arrays, front‑end electronics, and digital signal processing chains

- Lead research in C‑UUV detection, tracking, and defeat concepts, including sensing modalities, classification algorithms, and autonomous behaviors

- Direct efforts in noise control and signature management for undersea platforms and sensors

- Oversee embedded and real‑time processing architectures (e.g., FPGAs, GPUs, SBCs) supporting autonomy, signal processing, and C2

- Maintain awareness of state‑of‑the‑art undersea technologies and incorporate relevant advances into ongoing and future programs

Who you are:

- Active clearance with special access eligibility, for which U.S citizenship is needed by the U.S government

- Advanced degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Ocean Engineering, Acoustics, Robotics, or a closely related field, and substantial experience (typically 5-12+ years depending on degree) in undersea systems, sensing, or robotics; or equivalent combination of education and experience

- Experience as a technical lead on a complex R&D program, preferably in undersea or maritime domains

- Deep hands‑on experience in at least one core area:

- 

- Acoustic underwater sensing and signal processing

- Counter‑UUV or undersea defense systems

- Undersea robotics and autonomy

- Noise control / signature management for undersea platforms

- Proven ability to:

- Develop innovative technical concepts and architectures

- Write and win competitive proposals or lead major technical captures

- Plan and manage technical execution for multidisciplinary teams

- Strong systems‑engineering mindset, including requirements development, architecture definition, trade studies, and verification/validation

- Practical familiarity with embedded systems and real‑time control (e.g., microcontrollers, FPGAs, SBCs) and their role in undersea platforms and sensing systems

- Experience with modeling, simulation, or analytical tools to set and assess performance expectations for UUVs or sensor systems

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief senior stakeholders and customers

Even Better:

- Experience with non-linear acoustics including parametric acoustic arrays is highly desirable

- Prior experience as a Principal Investigator or Chief Engineer on undersea robotics, UUV, advanced sensing, or complex R&D programs

- Experience designing electronics and systems for marine or other harsh environments (pressure, corrosion, moisture, vibration)

- Familiarity with robotic and autonomy frameworks (e.g., ROS, MOOS‑IvP, UMAA) and their integration with vehicle electronics and sensing systems

- Experience with advanced acoustic signal processing including array processing, detection, classification, localization, and tracking

- Background in control systems, sensor fusion, and their implications for hardware design, timing, and system architecture

- Experience with hardware‑in‑the‑loop (HIL) test setups, system‑level simulation, and at‑sea test campaigns, including deployment, operation, and recovery

- Experience interacting with the U.S. Navy or other U.S. Government organizations, including classified or special access programs

- Active Top Secret security clearance and prior special access program experience

- Experience with agile development methodologies and modern configuration management (e.g., Git) for hardware, firmware, and analysis tools

This role is suited for a technical leader who thrives at the intersection of innovation, customer engagement, and hands‑on engineering, and who wants to shape the next generation of undersea sensing and robotic capabilities.

 Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to contribute to the development of groundbreaking undersea robotic and sensing systems that will shape the future of maritime autonomy. You will work alongside a passionate and talented team, tackling some of the most challenging and rewarding problems in the field. If you are a visionary roboticist with a drive to innovate and lead, we want to hear from you.

Apply today and help us redefine what’s possible beneath the waves.

Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $220,000 - $260,000

postings.description:
Principal Mission Engineer (Full Stack) (Secret Clearance Required)

The Team: 

Information processing and sense-making systems are the lifeblood of national security efforts, facilitating an understanding of the global situation, strategic planning, and tactical execution. The reliability, accessibility, and sophistication of these systems can determine the outcomes of conflicts before they begin. STR’s Analytics and Command & Control (AC2) Division focuses on developing actionable, advanced technology solutions to provide asymmetric advantages within the information domain. 

The Mission Applications (MA) Group within the AC2 Division specializes in ensuring the technology that STR creates produces outsized mission impact. Staff within the MA group have a deep understanding of missions and technology needs for national security with skills targeting transition of technology to operational use, including product management, UX Product implementation, software integration & mission engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, and program management. MA staff combine with other science and engineering staff from the various STR research and development groups to form dedicated product teams focused on accelerating the operational transition of cutting-edge software technologies. 

The Role: 

As a Principal Mission Engineer (Full Stack) in the Mission Applications Group, you will develop and deploy software essential for a specific, real-world objective or "mission" in partnership with our customers. We are looking for engineers who are high ownership and have a track record of delivering high impact work. 

You have: 1) expertise in developing and deploying software solutions in complex and high-security environments, 2) deep domain knowledge in the complex missions executed across the Department of Defense, and 3) expertise in modern frameworks, building full stack applications, and integrating APIs for deployment in high-security environments. 

You will work as a leader of software teams to design, develop, and maintain software systems deployed in operational use. You have experience managing customer relationships while simultaneously leading engineering teams to ensure the delivered product meets the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance. This role includes: 

- Build Prototype Capabilities: Break down use cases and user-defined problems, build an MVP, and rapidly evolve a solution into a cohesive application. 

- Rapidly Scale Applications: Continue accelerated development trajectory on existing applications by building new workflows, increasing scalability and making high impact improvements, and addressing additional customer pain points in the context of existing applications and workflows. 

- Develop and Enhance Features: Create high-performance, visually appealing frontend solutions that handle complex use cases effectively. Ensure the product is fast, smooth, and intuitive to use, even under heavy load. 

- System Integration: Leading cross functional engineering teams to design, build, and deploy a cohesive system. Integrate independent capabilities into existing solutions. 

- Customer Collaboration: Working closely with end-users and customers, who are typically military or Government operators, to understand their requirements and translate them into software features. You are experienced in product discovery best practices. 

- Deployment and Field Testing: Traveling to integration sites to deploy, test, and triage software in secure operational environments. On average, travel to customer sites should not exceed one week per month. 

This role will take advantage of STR’s flexible, hybrid environment – when the work does not require use of STR’s or the customer’s facilities, you are welcome to work remotely.  

Who You Are: 

- Must be a U.S. citizen 

- Active US Security Clearance 

- BS in Computer Science or related technical field with at least 8 years of work experience 

- Experience deploying software for DoD or IC missions 

- High sense of ownership and a track record of delivering high impact work 

- A passion for crafting user-centric interfaces and a keen eye for design details 

- Demonstrated strong knowledge of modern technologies such as React, TypeScript, and Python 

- Knowledge of performance-focused tools and techniques for rendering large datasets and building responsive, smooth interfaces 

- A demonstrated ability to adopt new languages, libraries, and technologies 

- Organized, detail-oriented, and with an ability to work both independently and collaboratively 

- Demonstrated experience as an effective communicator to both technical and non-technical audiences 

Even Better: 

- Active Security Clearance at the Top Secret level with SCI Eligibility 

- Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related technical field 

- Prior US Military Service with experience in joint planning, large force battle monitoring, and fluidity with large force debrief best practices 

Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $240,000 - $290,000

postings.title: Principal Radar Systems Engineer
postings.description:
STR is focused on delivering National Defense capabilities by driving mission-focused strategies to develop advanced technology systems enabling enduring products and solutions focused on achieving the customer vision. Our programs deliver sustainable, reliable, and cost-efficient capabilities focused on end-customer needs that function in operationally relevant environments and timeframes. We consider the entire lifecycle of the solution, from conceptualization and architecting, through development to deployment, while leveraging novel technologies to deliver first-of-a-kind systems.

The Systems Development Division (SDD) within STR delivers technology advantage into users’ hands and is seeking a Principal Radar Systems Engineer to support/lead the architecting, design, development, and implementation of radar systems that meet challenging customer needs. You will collaborate with fellow researchers and engineers on multi-disciplinary teams to interpret and understand customer objectives and develop innovative solutions. You may direct and/or lead development efforts and junior engineers, as needed, in areas of focus including exploration and demonstration of Radar and EW/RF convergence. As a Systems Engineer, you will apply a broad perspective and understanding of the elements that comprise a complete, functioning radar system to architect solutions, be directly involved with implementing the solutions (hands-on engineering), and guide teams spanning software, hardware, integration and test. You should have experience defining leading teams, architecting complete radar systems, and working across the Systems Engineering Lifecycle, with familiarity in Digital Engineering/MBSE.

Strong interpersonal, communication, technical, and peer-leadership skills are required. Applicants are expected to be self-motivated, detail oriented and have a demonstrated ability to effectively communicate with all levels of management and individual contributors on the program team through strong written and verbal communication skills. You will be joining a dynamic team working across multiple disciplines with opportunities to further expand your knowledge and grow your career.

What you will do:

- Researching, understanding, and leading new RF sensing implementations for advanced radar solutions. Identifying new technical approaches and working with program and technical leadership to implement these approaches.

- Decomposing customer needs/complex problems and developing system concepts and solutions.

- Effectively using tools to create, evaluate, and document solutions and clearly communicate the solution to the team, STR management, and customers, which may include generating system models in Cameo.

- Designing, directing, and when necessary, implementing cutting-edge technology in multi-function radar systems.

- Conducting performance analysis through simulations and real-world testing to validate and optimize radar performance.

- Ensuring appropriate level of rigor is applied to achieve systems that meet customer needs.

- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to define system requirements, specifications and architectures for radars, and ensure seamless integration and interoperability of the system.

- Development and specification of simulation tools to facilitate test and verification of radar software and hardware components.

Who you are:

- This position requires an Active Secret security clearance, and ability to obtain a Top Secret (TS) clearance with eligibility to support special access programs (SAP), for which U.S. citizenship is needed by U.S. Government.

- Expert understanding of and experience with entire radar systems and their principles of design, development, requirements verification, test planning, test execution, data analysis, and operations support.

- In-depth knowledge of how to implement radar modes, including transmit and receive waveform generation and signal processing.

- Proficiency in radar simulation tools and MATLAB.

- Experience in preparing and delivering high-level briefings to customers and senior management. Interacting with decision-makers and customers to translate mission needs into an end-to-end solution.

- Familiarity with the execution of technical reviews (SRRs, PDRs, CDRs, TIMs).

- Demonstrated experience in leadership and delivery of advanced development projects.

- Minimum of 10 years work experience as a Radar Systems Engineer.

- Background should include a Bachelor’s degree and at least 10 years of applicable experience directly related to development and deployment of radar systems; Master’s degree and at least 8 years of applicable experience; or PhD and at least 5 years of applicable experience. Equivalent experience will be considered.

Even Better:

- 5+ years experience working with SysML models in Cameo (or similar tool).

- Experience working with software-intensive systems and open architecture.

- Familiarity with programming languages (e.g. C, C++, Python).

postings.description:
About the Team

The Sensors Division at STR focuses on technology development for advanced sensor systems and platforms in support of national security requirements. Our particular focus areas include airborne/spaceborne/surface-based radar, electronic warfare, underwater acoustics, hyperspectral imaging, and EO/IR sensing. To support these missions, the Division’s efforts span multiple technical areas, including RF analog/digital hardware, acoustic hardware, signal processing algorithms, machine learning algorithms, systems analysis, and real-time embedded processor implementation.

The Algorithms, Processing and Experimentation (APEX) Group specializes in development of RF/radar modes, skills and applications, with particular emphasis on advanced signal processing chains and associated algorithm research. We mature these technologies with the objective of implementation, integration, and eventual utility in RF-based systems, typically tailoring our work for highly specific Defense (e.g., Air Force, Space Force, Navy, DARPA, etc.) and Intelligence Community needs.

The Role:

We are seeking an experienced RF Systems Integration Engineer to lead RF test, measurement, and system integration activities in support of integrating a new operational mode onto an externally developed radar system. This role requires deep hands-on expertise in RF and radar systems, combined with the ability to understand, influence, and integrate with a complex radar platform owned and developed by another organization. You will serve as the technical authority for RF systems integration owning the end-to-end understanding of the radar, defining integration requirements, leading RF characterization and testing, and designing the technical approach required to successfully implement and validate our mode on the partner radar system.

What you will do: 

- Lead RF testing, measurement, and characterization efforts across lab, integration, and system-level environments

- Develop a deep technical understanding of a third-party radar system, including RF architecture, signal chains, modes, interfaces, and operational constraints

- Define and own the RF systems integration approach for implementing a new mode on an externally developed radar

- Translate system-level objectives into clear RF, interface, and integration requirements

- Design and validate integration strategies, including RF interfaces, timing, control, and signal processing impacts

- Collaborate closely with the external radar developer to resolve RF, system, and integration challenges Lead integration test planning, execution, and analysis, including defining success criteria and validation methods Identify risks and tradeoffs related to RF performance, integration complexity, and system compatibility

- Serve as the technical lead and escalation point for RF systems integration issues Communicate findings and recommendations to internal leadership and cross-organizational stakeholders

- Familiarity with RF component technology and performance characteristics

- Strong scientific programming skills including Matlab, Python, Simulink and/or C/C++

postings.description:
STR is hiring a Principal Software Reverse Engineer who has a passion for research and analysis of vulnerabilities in cyber physical systems. This opportunity will be part of a multidisciplinary team of researchers and engineers dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies with significant and immediate impact on our national security. This position offers an excellent opportunity to work at the nexus of computers and real-world physical systems. We believe that each employee has a unique set of skills, experiences, and perspectives that are essential to providing our customers with innovative solutions. The skills listed below are representative of those needed for this role but are not the only acceptable set. If you see an overlap with your skills, go ahead and apply!.

Work must be performed onsite and Active Top Secret (TS) Clearance required.

What you’ll do:

- Reverse engineering complex software or firmware targets, ranging from typical Windows/Linux binaries to embedded firmware running non-traditional computer architectures and operating systems

- Developing and applying automated reverse engineering and binary analysis tools to characterize protocols, interfaces, and functionality of target systems

- Developing innovative cybersecurity solutions

- Leading multi-discipline teams to tackle challenging problems from a wide variety of technologies to develop innovative cybersecurity solutions

- Performing vulnerability weaponization, exploit development, payload development, and exploit mitigation on a variety of challenging targets

- Technical marketing to existing and potential customers

- Technical proposal development (idea generation, writing, reviewing, editing)

- Documenting, demonstrating, and presenting research

- Solving real world problems that have an impact on national security

Who you are:

- This position requires an Active Top Secret (TS) security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is needed by the U.S. Government.

- Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity or related field plus a minimum of 15 years relevant experience
(MS or PhD with equivalent work experience may also be considered)

- Substantial experience leading technical teams on advanced reverse engineering and exploitation programs

- Experience with binary analysis of software/firmware

- Experience with disassembly tools, such as IDA Pro, Binary Ninja, or Ghidra

- Proficiency in multiple Assembly Languages: x86, ARM, etc.

- Proficiency in one or more programming languages: C/C++, Python, etc.

- Deep understanding of reverse engineering fundamentals

- Experience in Vulnerability research and analysis

- Knowledge of weaponizing discovered vulnerabilities into exploits

Nice to haves:

- Implant or software patch development

- Familiarity with binary emulation or vulnerability research, including tools such as QEMU or AFL++

- Experience with DSP architectures, such as Texas Instruments, STMicroelectronics, NXP, or Analog Devices.

- Knowledge of operating system internals including memory/process/thread management

- Embedded systems or firmware analysis

- Experience development custom emulation tools to enable dynamic analysis

- Disassembler/decompiler module development

- Experience analyzing and reconstructing code/data flow

- Automated reverse engineering or software analysis tool development

- Experience debugging software without source code

- Knowledge of binary file structures and formats

- Experience analyzing protocols or message structures

- Knowledge of anti-reverse engineering techniques

- Knowledge of intrusion detection and anti-malware systems and techniques

postings.title: Principal Software Reverse Engineer
postings.description:
STR is hiring a Principal Software Reverse Engineer who has a passion for research and analysis of vulnerabilities in cyber physical systems. This opportunity will be part of a multidisciplinary team of researchers and engineers dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies with significant and immediate impact on our national security. This position offers an excellent opportunity to work at the nexus of computers and real-world physical systems. We believe that each employee has a unique set of skills, experiences, and perspectives that are essential to providing our customers with innovative solutions. The skills listed below are representative of those needed for this role but are not the only acceptable set. If you see an overlap with your skills, go ahead and apply!.

Work must be performed onsite and Active Top Secret (TS) Clearance required.

What you’ll do:

- Reverse engineering complex software or firmware targets, ranging from typical Windows/Linux binaries to embedded firmware running non-traditional computer architectures and operating systems

- Developing and applying automated reverse engineering and binary analysis tools to characterize protocols, interfaces, and functionality of target systems

- Developing innovative cybersecurity solutions

- Leading multi-discipline teams to tackle challenging problems from a wide variety of technologies to develop innovative cybersecurity solutions

- Performing vulnerability weaponization, exploit development, payload development, and exploit mitigation on a variety of challenging targets

- Technical marketing to existing and potential customers

- Technical proposal development (idea generation, writing, reviewing, editing)

- Documenting, demonstrating, and presenting research

- Solving real world problems that have an impact on national security

Who you are:

- This position requires an Active Top Secret (TS) security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is needed by the U.S. Government.

- Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity or related field plus a minimum of 15 years relevant experience
(MS or PhD with equivalent work experience may also be considered)

- Substantial experience leading technical teams on advanced reverse engineering and exploitation programs

- Experience with binary analysis of software/firmware

- Experience with disassembly tools, such as IDA Pro, Binary Ninja, or Ghidra

- Proficiency in multiple Assembly Languages: x86, ARM, etc.

- Proficiency in one or more programming languages: C/C++, Python, etc.

- Deep understanding of reverse engineering fundamentals

- Experience in Vulnerability research and analysis

- Knowledge of weaponizing discovered vulnerabilities into exploits

Nice to haves:

- Implant or software patch development

- Familiarity with binary emulation or vulnerability research, including tools such as QEMU or AFL++

- Experience with DSP architectures, such as Texas Instruments, STMicroelectronics, NXP, or Analog Devices.

- Knowledge of operating system internals including memory/process/thread management

- Embedded systems or firmware analysis

- Experience development custom emulation tools to enable dynamic analysis

- Disassembler/decompiler module development

- Experience analyzing and reconstructing code/data flow

- Automated reverse engineering or software analysis tool development

- Experience debugging software without source code

- Knowledge of binary file structures and formats

- Experience analyzing protocols or message structures

- Knowledge of anti-reverse engineering techniques

- Knowledge of intrusion detection and anti-malware systems and techniques

postings.title: Principal Subcontracts Administrator
postings.description:
STR is seeking a highly motivated Principal Subcontracts Administrator to join our growing Contracts & Supply Chain team. The Principal, Subcontracts professional will lead and manage the full lifecycle of subcontracts across a diverse portfolio of government contracts. Responsibilities will include subcontracting strategy, solicitation, proposal evaluation, negotiation, award, post-award administration, compliance, performance management, modification, and closeout.

The successful candidate will serve as a subject-matter expert and trusted business partner to Program Management, Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain, Contracts, Legal, and other internal stakeholders. The role requires sound judgment, strong negotiation and communication skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to independently manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced federal contracting environment.

This position offers the opportunity to lead complex subcontracting activities, advise internal stakeholders, support purchasing-system compliance, contribute to process improvements, and help scale STR’s subcontract management practices as the company grows.

What you will do:

- Lead full lifecycle administration of a portfolio of subcontracts, including pre-award, award, post-award administration, modification, closeout, and records retention

- Partner with Contracts, Legal, Security, Quality, Finance, IT, and Program teams to develop and execute subcontracting strategies aligned with program requirements, prime contract obligations, company policies, and applicable acquisition regulations

- Oversee subcontractor due diligence, onboarding, risk classification, screening, periodic reviews, and compliance monitoring

- Prepare and issue requests for proposals and other solicitations to subcontractors

- Evaluate subcontractor proposals for price, cost, technical, schedule, contractual, and compliance considerations, as applicable

- Lead proposal analysis, including review of labor rates, indirect rates, assumptions, exceptions, terms and conditions, and cost or pricing information, as appropriate

- Draft, negotiate, and execute subcontracts, subcontract modifications, nondisclosure agreements, teaming-related agreements, and other special agreements

- Interpret and apply applicable Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS), prime contract requirements, and subcontract flowdown requirements

- Manage subcontract modifications, changes, deliverables, invoices, funding actions, approvals, and other post-award requirements

- Monitor subcontractor performance, including cost, schedule, technical performance, deliverables, compliance, and overall risk

- Partner with Program Management, Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain, Contracts, Legal, and other stakeholders to resolve subcontract-related issues and support successful program execution

- Support purchasing-system compliance activities, including communications with the Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA), preparation for Contractor Purchasing System Reviews (CPSRs), audit responses, and remediation activities

- Identify subcontracting risks and recommend mitigation strategies related to pricing, terms and conditions, intellectual property, data rights, cybersecurity, export controls, security requirements, organizational conflicts of interest, and other applicable compliance areas

- Develop and improve subcontracting procedures, templates, tools, and training to increase efficiency, consistency, and scalability

- Maintain appropriate records and evidence to support audits, customer reviews, certifications, and regulatory inquiries

- Serve as a trusted advisor and subject-matter expert on subcontracting matters across the organization

- Utilize purchasing and ERP systems

- Experience using AI‑enabled tools and a strong willingness to learn and apply AI to drive efficiency and improve quality and effectiveness in Contracts and Supply Chain processes

Who you are:

- This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a US government security clearance, if required for assigned programs, for which US citizenship is needed by the US Government.

- Bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain, contracts, finance, or a related field, plus at least 7 years of relevant experience; equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered

- Significant experience administering subcontracts in a U.S. government contracting environment

- Experience supporting DoD and/or Intelligence Community customers

- Working knowledge of the FAR, DFARS, federal acquisition principles, and applicable subcontract flowdown requirements

- Experience with multiple contract types, such as firm-fixed-price (FFP), cost-plus-fixed-fee (CPFF), time-and-materials (T&M), labor-hour, and other cost-reimbursement arrangements

- Experience drafting, negotiating, administering, and managing subcontracts and related agreements

- Demonstrated ability to evaluate subcontractor proposals and perform or support price and cost analysis

- Experience supporting purchasing-system compliance, audits, CPSR preparation, or related government reviews

- Strong written, verbal, analytical, negotiation, and problem-solving skills

- Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and manage competing priorities

- Exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills

- Ability to collaborate, communicate, and coordinate effectively with internal and external stakeholders

Nice to have:

- Professional certification, such as NCMA’s Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM), Certified Federal Contracts Manager (CFCM), or a related credential.

- Experience supporting DoW, classified programs or Intelligence Community customers.

- Experience working with DCMA, the Defense Contract Audit Agency (DCAA), CPSRs, or other government audits and reviews.

- Experience with subcontract closeout, claims, disputes, equitable adjustments, or termination activities.

- Familiarity with export control, cybersecurity, intellectual property, data rights, and government property requirements.

- Experience implementing or improving subcontract management systems, processes, and internal controls.

- Experience mentoring or providing functional leadership to other contracts, procurement, or subcontract professionals.

postings.title: Senior Advanced RF Hardware Engineer
postings.description:
STR’s Cyber Division is hiring a Senior Advanced RF Hardware Engineer who will leverage their RF, analog/mixed signal and system test skills to contribute to a multi-disciplinary team engaged in solving unique problems. The successful candidate will be comfortable designing, analyzing, and characterizing a variety of hardware architectures to aid with software and hardware modeling efforts. They should have a firm grasp of the fundamentals of RF system architecture to support both software and hardware reverse engineering tasks and be able to use their hardware expertise to rapidly test prototype solutions.

We are seeking candidates with design experience to participate in the development of RF Hardware in the Loop (HWIL) systems, surrogate builds, digital twins, and hardware modeling support platforms that integrate a variety of electrical subsystems, ranging from commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) components to custom-designed boards. The successful candidate will contribute to the design process of a growing hardware team by participating in design reviews with comprehensive design documentation, building and executing automated test suites, and collaborating to ensure quality outputs and support for future design re-use.

What you will do:

- Develop rapid prototype RF solutions to go from free space to bits using a combination of COTS and custom designs

- Work in a laboratory environment utilizing test equipment (oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, VNAs etc.) to characterize and debug complex electronic systems

- Prepare and execute test events for customers and internal and external stakeholders

- Lead efforts to develop lab-based acquisition and control platforms to aid in test and characterization of hardware systems

- Serve as the hardware team representative on interdisciplinary efforts to contribute knowledge of system architecture and focused processor implementations

- Participate in proposal efforts by providing input on technical path and BOM/cost and schedule estimates

 Who you are:

- This position requires the ability to obtain a Top Secret (TS) security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is needed by U.S. Government

- BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field with 5 years of related experience OR a MS and 3 years

- Proven expertise of electrical circuit design principles in at least one of the following areas: RF, analog, or digital

- Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to mentor junior engineering staff

- Experience preparing and presenting technical material to customers and internal staff

- Experience leading hardware efforts from concept to implementation managing cost and scheduling requirements

 Nice to Haves:

- Active Top Secret (TS) Security Clearance

- Strong RF design or implementation background with experience in system analysis and component characterization

- Experience with FPGA forward and reverse engineering processes and methodology

- Experience with RF electromagnetics theory, antenna modeling, and link budget analysis for OTA testing

- Experience integrating and working with software defined radios and RFSOC platforms

- Experience developing PCB-based designs and implementing FPGA and embedded software to support HWIL and surrogate designs

- Experience with Analog and RF circuit simulation and modeling tools (e.g., Spice, MATLAB/Simulink, Microwave Office)

- Experience in DSP or other signal processing skills

- Experience using and developing tools and test software for Linux (e.g., Red Hat, Ubuntu)

- Software development in support of RF systems testing with a variety of tools/packages in MATLAB, Python, or C++

- Knowledge of PCB design and fabrication principles and familiarity with industry standard CAD tools (e.g., Cadence, Altium, Eagle)

- Digital/FPGA HDL experience using dedicated design tools (e.g., Vivado, Quartus, Simulink/HDL Coder)

postings.title: Senior Algorithm & Signal Processing Researcher
postings.description:
About the Team:

The Sensors Division at STR focuses on technology development for advanced sensor systems and platforms in support of national security requirements. Our particular focus areas include airborne/spaceborne/surface-based radar, electronic warfare, underwater acoustics, hyperspectral imaging, and EO/IR sensing. To support these missions, the Division’s efforts span multiple technical areas, including RF analog/digital hardware, acoustic hardware, signal processing algorithms, machine learning algorithms, systems analysis, and real-time embedded processor implementation.

The Algorithms, Processing and Experimentation (APEX) Group specializes in development of RF/radar modes, skills and applications, with particular emphasis on advanced signal processing chains and associated algorithm research. We mature these technologies with the objective of implementation, integration, and eventual utility in RF-based systems, typically tailoring our work for highly specific Defense (e.g., Air Force, Space Force, Navy, DARPA, etc.) and Intelligence Community needs.

About the Role:

As a Senior Algorithm and Signal Processing Engineer, you will develop, implement, test, and demonstrate novel signal processing, optimization, and machine learning algorithms for advanced electronic warfare, radar, and remote sensing applications. You will work as part of multidisciplinary teams to research next-generation sensing concepts and transition advanced algorithms into integrated systems for laboratory and field demonstrations.

A successful candidate will have expertise in one or more of the following areas: signal processing, adaptive radar signal processing, optimization, machine learning, electronic warfare, algorithm development, radar systems, communications systems, RF remote sensing, resource management, modeling and simulation, or related technical fields. This position requires strong analytical skills, scientific programming experience, and the ability to collaborate with researchers, engineers, and customers to solve challenging technical problems.

What You Will Do

- Develop advanced sensing concepts, signal processing algorithms, and machine learning techniques for radar, electronic warfare, and remote sensing applications

- Research, design, implement, and evaluate novel algorithms from concept through demonstration

- Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to architect, develop, integrate, and test advanced RF signal processing systems

- Support modeling and simulation activities to evaluate algorithm performance and inform system design

- Plan and execute laboratory and field testing to assess algorithm performance and transition research into operational prototypes.

- Contribute to technical proposals, customer interactions, presentations, and technical briefings

- Survey emerging research and incorporate state-of-the-art techniques into practical algorithm solutions.

Who You Are

- Ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is required by the U.S. government

- PhD, MS, or BS in Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline with 2-5+ years relevant experience

- Strong programming skills in MATLAB, Python, C/C++, or similar scientific computing languages

- Strong mathematical, analytical, troubleshooting, written, and verbal communication skills

- Experience developing, implementing, testing, or analyzing signal processing, optimization, or machine learning algorithms

- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

- Ability to translate research objectives and customer needs into practical technical solutions

Even Better

- Active Top Secret security clearance

- Experience with radar systems, RF remote sensing, electronic warfare, or communications systems

- Experience with adaptive signal processing, waveform design, multidimensional signal processing, resource management, or system optimization

- Experience developing algorithms for real-time or embedded systems

- Experience with modeling and simulation, algorithm integration, and system test and evaluation

- Experience with software development and scientific computing workflows

- Ability to survey technical literature, identify emerging approaches, and transition research into integrated, tested solutions

Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $139,000 - $170,000

postings.title: Senior Algorithm & Signal Processing Researcher
postings.description:
About the Team:

The Sensors Division at STR focuses on technology development for advanced sensor systems and platforms in support of national security requirements. Our particular focus areas include airborne/spaceborne/surface-based radar, electronic warfare, underwater acoustics, hyperspectral imaging, and EO/IR sensing. To support these missions, the Division’s efforts span multiple technical areas, including RF analog/digital hardware, acoustic hardware, signal processing algorithms, machine learning algorithms, systems analysis, and real-time embedded processor implementation.

The Algorithms, Processing and Experimentation (APEX) Group specializes in development of RF/radar modes, skills and applications, with particular emphasis on advanced signal processing chains and associated algorithm research. We mature these technologies with the objective of implementation, integration, and eventual utility in RF-based systems, typically tailoring our work for highly specific Defense (e.g., Air Force, Space Force, Navy, DARPA, etc.) and Intelligence Community needs.

About the Role:

As a Senior Algorithm and Signal Processing Engineer, you will develop, implement, test, and demonstrate novel signal processing, optimization, and machine learning algorithms for advanced electronic warfare, radar, and remote sensing applications. You will work as part of multidisciplinary teams to research next-generation sensing concepts and transition advanced algorithms into integrated systems for laboratory and field demonstrations.

A successful candidate will have expertise in one or more of the following areas: signal processing, adaptive radar signal processing, optimization, machine learning, electronic warfare, algorithm development, radar systems, communications systems, RF remote sensing, resource management, modeling and simulation, or related technical fields. This position requires strong analytical skills, scientific programming experience, and the ability to collaborate with researchers, engineers, and customers to solve challenging technical problems.

What You Will Do

- Develop advanced sensing concepts, signal processing algorithms, and machine learning techniques for radar, electronic warfare, and remote sensing applications

- Research, design, implement, and evaluate novel algorithms from concept through demonstration

- Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to architect, develop, integrate, and test advanced RF signal processing systems

- Support modeling and simulation activities to evaluate algorithm performance and inform system design

- Plan and execute laboratory and field testing to assess algorithm performance and transition research into operational prototypes.

- Contribute to technical proposals, customer interactions, presentations, and technical briefings

- Survey emerging research and incorporate state-of-the-art techniques into practical algorithm solutions.

- Strong programming skills in MATLAB, Python, C/C++, or similar scientific computing languages

- Strong mathematical, analytical, troubleshooting, written, and verbal communication skills

- Experience developing, implementing, testing, or analyzing signal processing, optimization, or machine learning algorithms

- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

- Ability to translate research objectives and customer needs into practical technical solutions

Even Better

- Active Top Secret security clearance

- Experience with radar systems, RF remote sensing, electronic warfare, or communications systems

- Experience developing algorithms for real-time or embedded systems

- Experience with modeling and simulation, algorithm integration, and system test and evaluation

postings.title: Senior Cloud Software Engineer
postings.description:
Senior Cloud Software Engineer 

Information processing systems are the lifeblood of national security efforts, facilitating an understanding of the global situation, strategic planning, and tactical execution. The reliability, accessibility, and sophistication of these systems can determine the outcomes of conflicts before they begin.  STR’s Systems Development Division (SDD) focuses on developing actionable, advanced technology solutions to provide asymmetric advantages within the information domain. SDD considers the entire lifecycle of the solution, from conceptualization and architecting, through development, to deployment, while leveraging novel technologies to deliver first-of-a-kind systems. Current efforts include programs for airborne and space RF as well as advanced testing enabled by multi-function, multi-modal capabilities. 

As a Senior Cloud Software Engineer in SDD, you will work with the software team on implementation of Continuous Integration/ Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for software integrating complex embedded RF systems, signal processing, and radar, with a primary focus on Air-to-Air applications.  

What you will do: 

- Perform DevSecOps pipeline implementation including development, deployment, maintenance, optimization and operation of all phases of the DevSecOps process and tool chain 

- Support DevSecOps pipelines in unclassified and classified environments using a variety of code quality tools 

- Configure and maintain multiple development and DevOps environments at different classification levels, focusing on developer productivity, application performance, security monitoring, and alerting 

- Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure team infrastructure toolsets are configured, maintained, and reliable, in compliance with program requirements and Department of Defense standards 

- Coach team members on DevSecOps best practices while continuously helping to improve and automate processes 

- Debug compilation, pipeline, infrastructure and configuration failures 

- Identify areas for improvement and implement enhancements 

- Document the pipeline architecture, tools and user processes to modify and update pipelines 

Evangelize DevOps and DevSecOps and support the software team on tooling, environments, debugging and testing. 

Who You Are: 

- Must be a U.S. citizen 

- Ability to obtain a Top-Secret Security Clearance 

- BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related technical field 

- Demonstrated experience working with DevSecOps pipelines, preferably on a DoD development effort 

- Proficiency with build, continuous integration, and continuous deployment tools. Preferred: Demonstrated experience with Bazel, CMake, GCC, GitLab, Jenkins, GTest, GCov, clang-tools. 

- Comfortable in Linux and Windows environments. Experience administering linux systems in a CMMC compliant environment on bare metal. Basic windows system administration is a plus. 

- Strong scripting, coding (C or C++), and configuration management skills to write, maintain, and document automation and integrate tooling, including ability to debug compilation and run time failures. 

- Experience with containerization technologies such as docker, WSL, podman, and container orchestration tools like Kubernetes, Swarm, and Rancher 

- Experience with cloud service providers such as AWS or Azure in an IL4/IL5/IL6 environment 

- Familiarity with security scanning tools such as SonarQube, Coverity, Syft, Grype, Artifactory Xray with advanced Security, Semgrep, and Anchore and best practices for secure design, coding, and analysis 

- Familiarity with IT configuration and deployment management tools like Ansible, Chef, or TerraformFamiliarity with monitoring and logging tools (e.g. Grafana, ELK Stack, or Splunk) 

- General understanding of networking concepts and security protocols, and ability to configure and manage network security measures for development environments and tooling 

- Knowledge of automation frameworks and tools to streamline repetitive tasks and manage complex workflows 

Even Better: 

- Active Security Clearance 

- Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related technical field 

- Domain expertise in one or more of the following areas: Electronic Warfare, Antenna Apertures, Sensor Resource Management, Large-Scale Platform Test Systems, Cyber Physical Systems, Open System Architectures (UCI, OMS, COARPS) 

- Demonstrated expertise in C++, C++/Cuda 

- Experience utilizing the following: 

- Object-Oriented Programming principles 

- Agile software lifecycle methodologies and tools 

- Test-driven development methodologies 

Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $138,000 - $185,000

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

postings.title: Senior Cyber RF Hardware Engineer
postings.description:
STR’s Cyber Division is hiring a Senior Cyber RF Hardware Engineer who will leverage their RF, analog/mixed signal and system test skills to contribute to a multi-disciplinary team engaged in solving unique problems. The successful candidate will be comfortable designing, analyzing, and characterizing a variety of hardware architectures to aid with software and hardware modeling efforts. They should have a firm grasp of the fundamentals of RF system architecture to support both software and hardware reverse engineering tasks and be able to use their hardware expertise to rapidly test prototype solutions.

We are seeking candidates with design experience to participate in the development of RF Hardware in the Loop (HWIL) systems, surrogate builds, digital twins, and hardware modeling support platforms that integrate a variety of electrical subsystems, ranging from commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) components to custom-designed boards. The successful candidate will contribute to the design process of a growing hardware team by participating in design reviews with comprehensive design documentation, building and executing automated test suites, and collaborating to ensure quality outputs and support for future design re-use.

What you will do:

- Develop rapid prototype RF solutions to go from free space to bits using a combination of COTS and custom designs

- Work in a laboratory environment utilizing test equipment (oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, VNAs etc.) to characterize and debug complex electronic systems

- Prepare and execute test events for customers and internal and external stakeholders

- Lead efforts to develop lab-based acquisition and control platforms to aid in test and characterization of hardware systems

- Serve as the hardware team representative on interdisciplinary efforts to contribute knowledge of system architecture and focused processor implementations

- Participate in proposal efforts by providing input on technical path and BOM/cost and schedule estimates

 Who you are:

- This position requires the ability to obtain a Top Secret (TS) security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is needed by U.S. Government

- BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field with 5 years of related experience OR a MS and 3 years

- Proven expertise of electrical circuit design principles in at least one of the following areas: RF, analog, or digital

- Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to mentor junior engineering staff

- Experience preparing and presenting technical material to customers and internal staff

- Experience leading hardware efforts from concept to implementation managing cost and scheduling requirements

 Nice to Haves:

- Active Top Secret (TS) Security Clearance

- Strong RF design or implementation background with experience in system analysis and component characterization

- Experience with FPGA forward and reverse engineering processes and methodology

- Experience with RF electromagnetics theory, antenna modeling, and link budget analysis for OTA testing

- Experience integrating and working with software defined radios and RFSOC platforms

- Experience developing PCB-based designs and implementing FPGA and embedded software to support HWIL and surrogate designs

- Experience with Analog and RF circuit simulation and modeling tools (e.g., Spice, MATLAB/Simulink, Microwave Office)

- Experience in DSP or other signal processing skills

- Experience using and developing tools and test software for Linux (e.g., Red Hat, Ubuntu)

- Software development in support of RF systems testing with a variety of tools/packages in MATLAB, Python, or C++

- Knowledge of PCB design and fabrication principles and familiarity with industry standard CAD tools (e.g., Cadence, Altium, Eagle)

- Digital/FPGA HDL experience using dedicated design tools (e.g., Vivado, Quartus, Simulink/HDL Coder)

- Work as part of a high-functioning team to apply advanced software engineering principles to develop robust, resilient software solutions for national security missions

The Sensors Division within STR focuses on the development and analysis of advanced sensor systems in the RF, acoustic, and electro-optical domains. This includes the design and development of novel sensors and advanced information processing techniques from ideation to prototype implementations. The Subsea and Seabed Systems (SSS) Group develops and delivers advanced undersea sensor and signal processing systems related to intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) and counter-ISR applications.

The SSS Group is hiring an embedded signal processing engineer to design, develop, and test embedded software implementing signal processing algorithms for distributed undersea acoustic systems. Key to this role is the ability to span signal processing theory & concepts, software development and coding practices, and development on real-time embedded processing hardware ranging from low size-weight-and-power (SWAP) to high performance. 

Strong embedded coding with a range of languages (C++, python if supported, etc.) and experience implementing signal processing algorithms on low-power processors is expected. A successful candidate will also have working knowledge in multiple of the following areas: interfacing with analog-to-digital and digital-to-analog converters, analog and digital filters, build development containers, software development practices, mathematics, and/or scientific computing.

- Design, develop, and optimize real-time acoustic signal processing algorithms

- Implement software on various hardware platforms, including low-SWAP processors, ARM processors, and server-class processors

- Utilize development containers, git repositories, and Jira for efficient task management and collaboration

- Ensure software meets stringent real-time and high-fidelity requirements

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, integrate, and validate software on target hardware for distributed undersea systems

Who You Are:

- Signal Processing Knowledge: Solid understanding of acoustic signal processing principles and techniques with experience in acoustic array processing

- Software Optimization Skills: Ability to optimize software for performance and resource constraints on low-SWAP processors

- Optimization Algorithm Experience: Ability to apply optimization algorithms of various types to physical design and signal processing problems, for example adaptive signal processing

- Real-Time Processing: Proven ability to design and implement real-time deterministic algorithms for acoustic signal processing

- Programming Languages: Proficiency in low-level programming languages (C/C++) and high-level languages (MATLAB, Python)

- Operating Systems: Experience with LINUX operating systems, particularly in embedded environments

- Development Tools: Familiarity with development containers, version control systems (git), and task management tools (Jira)

- Collaboration: Strong team player with excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset

- Analytic Thinking and Communication: Strong Mathematical, troubleshooting, written, and verbal communication skills

- Active Security Clearance with eligibility to support special access programs, for which U.S citizenship is needed by the U.S government

Even Better:

- Autonomy software experience: Proficiency in Mission Oriented Operating Suite Interval Programming (MOOS-IvP) and Laboratory for Autonomous Marine Sensing Systems (LAMSS) use with embedded systems

postings.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer (Top Secret Clearance)
postings.description:
Senior Embedded Software Engineer

The Systems Development Division (SDD) delivers technology advantage into users’ hands by delivering capabilities focused on end-customer needs that function in operationally relevant environments and timeframes. SDD considers the entire lifecycle of the solution, from conceptualization and architecting, through development, to deployment, while leveraging novel technologies to deliver first-of-a-kind systems. Current efforts include programs for airborne and space RF as well as advanced testing enabled by multi-function, multi-modal capabilities.

SDD is seeking a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to support the design, development, and implementation of real-time processing solutions in software for advanced multi-function Radar systems. You will collaborate with fellow researchers and engineers on multi-disciplinary teams to develop innovative solutions related to exploration and demonstration of Radar and EW/RF convergence. In this role, you will identify and evaluate technical approaches, design and implement digital signal processing architectures, and deliver solutions over the complete signal processing chain for radar applications in various operational environments. Since the systems SDD develops are deployed in operationally relevant environments, the products you develop need to meet standards of quality, maintainability, and reuse. 

The successful candidate will have demonstrated contributions in areas such as radar, electronic warfare, digital signal processing, systems engineering, and test & evaluation. This position requires skills in working with multi-disciplinary teams, awareness of relevant technologies, and interest in developing and delivering systems in tight timeframes. Strong interpersonal, communication, and technical skills are required. Applicants are expected to be self-motivated, detail oriented and have a demonstrated ability to effectively communicate.

What you will do:

- Architect, design, direct, and implement cutting-edge embedded software in multi-function, deliverable/deployable systems

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand and/or develop system requirements and specifications Research, understand, and lead new embedded software implementations. Identifying new technical approaches and working with leadership to create/refine technology/product roadmaps

- Effectively use tools to create, evaluate, and document solutions and clearly communicate the solution to the team, STR management and customers

- Design and implement signal processing and software solutions

- Conduct performance analysis through simulations and real-world testing to validate and optimize system performance

- Prepare documentation, design specifications, test plans, and reports

- Communicate effectively with internal teams and stakeholders to convey technical concepts and project updates

Who you are:

- This position requires an Active Top Secret security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is needed by the U.S. Government

- BS in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field

- Demonstrated expertise implementing real-time signal processing solutions in C++ (C++17 or later)

- Demonstrated experience with CUDA

- Demonstrated knowledge of digital signal processing

- Applicable understanding of and experience with Radar systems and their principles of design, development, requirements verification, test planning, test execution, and data analysis

- Experience with algorithm implementation in software for real time systems, especially radar and/or remote sensing

- Experience in preparing and delivering briefings, familiarity with the execution of technical reviews (SRRs, PDRs, CDRs, TIMS)

- Capable of working in a team environment and interacting with team members to ensure effective communication and alignment including mentoring of junior engineers

postings.title: Senior Engineer
postings.description:
Software Engineer

About the Team:

The Sensors Division at STR focuses on technology development for advanced sensor systems, particularly in the areas of airborne/surface-based radar, electronic warfare, underwater acoustics, hyperspectral imaging, and EO/IR sensing. Within this role, we perform work on full system prototypes, experiment campaigns and technology component development. Development roles within the Sensors Division include RF analog/digital hardware, acoustic hardware, signal processing algorithms, machine learning algorithms, tracking/fusion, as well as real-time embedded processor implementation.

Within the Sensors Division, the Maritime Domain Applications (MDA) Group focuses on development of advanced sensing concepts utilizing adaptive signal processing, resource management, advanced algorithm development, as well as executing advanced sensor concept demonstrations.

The Role:

The MDA Group is seeking a Software Engineer to join a team supporting a critical ongoing national security mission. Our work spans the development of new algorithms and sensing concepts through their implementation in efficient software for real-world systems.

The Software Engineer will work as part of MDA’s team of algorithm developers, sensor domain experts, and software engineers, to maintain and enhance an established operational system. A successful candidate will be an entry to mid-level computer science graduate with a desire to develop and deploy novel solutions for real mission impact. Candidates should have relevant experience working with modular C/C++ software in a Linux environment (internship or course work is applicable).

This position involves working as part of multidisciplinary teams to develop, analyze, implement, and test solutions to challenging sensing problems. Strong technical, interpersonal, communication, and problem-solving skills are desired

What you will do:

- Work closely with a small, dedicated research team to develop innovative solutions to complex problems

- Support algorithm engineers and scientists to mature advanced algorithms by transforming prototype implementations (Python/MATLAB) into production software (C/C++)

- Maintain and enhance high-quality software for ongoing real world operational users

- Use High-Performance Computing (HPC) Linux environments to build and validate software solutions

- Enhance system quality through software investigations while building domain expertise

Who you are:

- U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain a Security Clearance

- BS+ 2 years or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or related field

- Intellectually curious and self-driven, with a desire to deliver high-impact technical solutions

- Strong programming skills in C/C++, including pointers and memory management

- Familiar with Python or MATLAB programming languages

- Familiar with source code management (GIT) and Linux development environments

- Team player with excellent communication skills, both verbal and written

- Willing to work full-time onsite (STR Arlington or Woburn)

 Even Better:

- Active Secret or Top Secret (TS) clearance

- 2+ years of programming experience in C++ (object-oriented, multi-threaded)

- 2+ years of programming experience in Python with scientific libraries (numpy, scipy, pandas)

- Solid foundations and interest in scientific computing (mathematics, physics, signal processing

- Familiarity with radar or optical systems data and processing, remote sensing, signal processing

postings.title: Senior FPGA Reverse Engineer
postings.description:
STR’s Cyber Division is hiring a Senior FPGA Reverse Engineer who will leverage their digital hardware design background to work within a multi-disciplinary team solving unique problems surrounding FPGA reverse engineering.

We are seeking a candidate to execute FPGA reverse engineering tasks and support software development to improve and automate the process. A key responsibility will be netlist analysis, which involves studying gate-level layouts of FPGA applications to craft a behavioral understanding of the design through a combination of logic circuit analysis and characterization through register transfer level (RTL) simulations. Candidates will also support efforts in operationalizing emerging hardware reverse engineering capabilities to better enable gate-level netlist analysis. Tool development involves writing software leveraging existing frameworks and insight based on the FPGA reverse engineering process to improve STR’s capability in this emerging field. A FPGA reverse engineer should be prepared to brief the internal team and STR’s customers on RE findings and provide updates on tool development.

What you will do:

- Perform FPGA reverse engineering work within a team to identify behavioral details of an application

- Model, test, and document RE findings using hardware modeling and simulation platforms

- Prepare reports and presentations for STR’s customers and collaborators detailing FPGA RE findings

- Assist in research for emerging FPGA and hardware reverse engineering capabilities

- Develop software supporting STR’s FPGA reverse engineering capabilities and identify new areas for tool development

- Participate in design reviews and testing for FPGA RE tools

Who you are:

- This position requires the ability to obtain a Top Secret (TS) security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is needed by the U.S. Government

- Bachelors Degree in Computer Engineering/Electrical & Computer Engineering with at least 5 years of relevant experience

- Strong problem solving skills and ability to apply a technical background to non-traditional problems

- Experience working with hardware description languages (i.e., Verilog, SystemVerilog, VHDL)

- Experience developing applications targeting FPGAs including design, synthesis, and configuration

- In depth knowledge of industry standard FPGAs (i.e., Altera, Xilinx), their development environments (i.e., Quartus, Vivado), RTL simulation, and project compilation workflows

- Strong background with digital design and logic concepts

- Software development experience ideally in Python, C, and/or C++

- Ability to prepare and present technical material to customers and internal staff

Nice to have:

- Active Top Secret (TS) Security Clearance

- Deep knowledge of FPGA architecture

- Hardware troubleshooting experience including using logic analyzers and oscilloscopes

- Experience using Matlab and Simulink

- Embedded systems experience including sensor interfacing with an FPGA or microcontroller

- Knowledge of signal processing implementation techniques common to FPGA implementations

- Leadership experience especially for hardware, FPGA, and/or embedded systems design efforts

Full-Time Salary Range: $138,000 - $189,000
