postings.title: Senior Model-Based Systems Engineer
postings.description:
STR is hiring a Senior Model-Based Systems Engineer (MBSE) in our Woburn, MA office to work across a broad portfolio of DoD mission areas. The Systems Engineer should have experience architecting systems, working across the Systems Engineering Lifecycle, a deep understanding of Systems Engineering principles, reverse engineering techniques, and the ability to work with complex software systems and the utilization of Digital Engineering/MBSE to accomplish program goals. The candidate will support STR’s Systems Development Division to achieve architectural integrity and traceability from requirements analysis through system and software development and production system deployment.

This position offers the opportunity to work with leading domain experts developing solutions to solve the most challenging national security problems. Our teams consist of motivated individuals with degrees in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics, and data science. The ideal candidate will be experienced in Systems Engineering processes and techniques, Modeling and Simulation, software-based systems, Digital Engineering/MBSE and be excited about opportunities to grow and be a source of subject matter expertise across the organization.

The Systems Engineer should have experience implementing a rigorous MBSE approach to develop DoD systems. New programs at STR will be looking to adopt agile approaches that incorporate model-based requirements management and traceability with software development. This position is well suited for a Systems Engineer with a software systems background who is interested in improving the state of the practice and demonstrating the advantages that MBSE can offer.

What you will do:

- Utilize your Systems Engineering skillset as part of a tightly knit team to design, develop, implement, and deploy advanced software systems

- Analyze, reverse-engineer, derive, and define requirements from ambiguous or incomplete software system implementations and codebases

- Develop/generate documentation (e.g. Systems Requirements Document, SysML models) to capture requirements of new and existing systems

- Perform gap analysis between derived requirements and current system capabilities to identify missing features or functionalities

- Assist other technical contributors throughout the software lifecycle, from early prototypes to fully integrated systems

- Implement MBSE approaches using SysML in Cameo

- Work closely with domain experts and software development teams to realize program designs for a diverse set of applications, including:

- Distributed mission planning

- Intelligence Surveillance Reconnaissance (ISR) management

- Decision making support to human analysts/planners

- This position is based in one of our offices but will take advantage of STR’s flexible, hybrid environment: we anticipate that you could work remotely as much as 25% of the time

- Any time work does not require use of STR’s facilities, you are welcome to work remotely

Who you are:

- This position requires an Active DoD Top Secret Clearance with SCI eligibility, for which U.S. citizenship is needed by U.S. Government

- BS, MS or PhD in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field

- Experience implementing open architectures and integrating with large scale software-intensive systems and platform systems

- Strong ability to derive requirements from existing software and capture new customer requirements, and translate those into development tasks for software teams

- Comfortable working in dynamic environments and adjusting to changing priorities

- Minimum of 5 years work experience as a Systems Engineer or related field

- Minimum of 3 years experience architecting systems using system modeling tools (SysML in Cameo)

Even Better:

- Domain expertise or familiarity with one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:

- Sea, air, and space platforms, mission planning, and C2 systems

- Sensor Resource Management

postings.title: Senior Radar Systems Engineer
postings.description:
STR is focused on delivering National Defense capabilities by driving mission-focused strategies to develop advanced technology systems enabling enduring products and solutions focused on achieving the customer vision. Our programs deliver sustainable, reliable, and cost-efficient capabilities focused on end-customer needs that function in operationally relevant environments and timeframes. We consider the entire lifecycle of the solution, from conceptualization and architecting, through development to deployment, while leveraging novel technologies to deliver first-of-a-kind systems.

The Systems Development Division (SDD) within STR delivers technology advantage into users’ hands. We are seeking a Senior Radar Systems Engineer to support Systems Engineering activities related to radar systems development: working with customers to understand and decompose their requirements, defining expected external system interactions and integration requirements, deriving and allocating system requirements to software and hardware components, and to work closely with development teams to capture and maintain system design artifacts. You will work as part of a multi-disciplinary team of engineers to ensure that the Systems Engineering process is followed and properly captured to support required program design deliverables and review gates. As part of complete radar system development, you will work closely with software and hardware teams to capture system architectures of different radar modes and EW applications. You will be responsible for maintaining key systems engineering metrics to support program execution and communication with customers and management. You will leverage your experience capturing complex system designs in digital representations such as SysML using modeling tools like Cameo. 

As a Systems Engineer, you will also contribute to defining and executing analysis that will help assess radar performance. You will work with Chief Engineers, and development team leads to ensure that requirements are verified according to program expectations and are appropriately reflected in test plans and verification artifacts. You will have the opportunity to work across the full Systems Engineering lifecycle, working with hardware and software teams to learn and help test the functionality of subsystems such as the active electronically scanned antenna (AESA), digital receiver/exciter (DREX), inertial navigation system (INS), as well as the processor, power, and cooling subsystems.

Strong interpersonal, communication, and technical skills are required. Applicants are expected to be self-motivated, detail oriented and have a demonstrated ability to effectively communicate with all levels of management and individual contributors on the program team through strong written and verbal communication skills. You will be joining a dynamic team working across multiple disciplines with opportunities to further expand your knowledge and grow your career.

What you will do:

- Support the execution of a complete Systems Engineering process for radar system development programs

- Support program Chief Engineers and Systems Engineering leads in the decomposition of complex customer needs through derivation and allocation to subsystems and components.

- Effectively use tools to create, evaluate, and document system architectures and clearly communicate the solution to the team, STR management, and customers, which may include generating system models in Cameo.

- Support the evaluation system performance leveraging modeling and simulation.

- Participate in field testing to validate and optimize radar performance.

- Ensure appropriate level of rigor is applied to achieve systems that meet customer needs.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define system requirements, specifications and architectures for radars, and ensure seamless integration and interoperability of the system.

Who you are:

- This position requires an Active Secret security clearance, and ability to obtain a Top Secret (TS) clearance with eligibility to support special access programs (SAP), for which U.S. citizenship is needed by U.S. Government.

- Experience with entire radar systems and their principles of design, development, requirements verification, test planning, test execution, data analysis, and operations support.

- Experience in mapping from high-level mission needs to radar and EW system specifications related to parameters such as sensitivity, linearity, phase noise, inertial navigation system errors, instantaneous bandwidth, system latency, etc.

- Experience with capturing radar mode designs such as SAR, GMTI, AMTI and associated transmit and receive waveforms and signal processing chains.

- Experience with simulation tools and MATLAB.

- Experience in preparing and delivering briefings to customers and senior management.

- Familiarity with the execution of technical reviews (SRRs, PDRs, CDRs, TIMs).

- Background should include a Bachelor’s degree and at least 3 years of applicable experience directly related to development and deployment of radar systems; Master’s degree and at least 1 years of applicable experience; or PhD. Equivalent experience will be considered.

Even Better:

- Experience working with SysML models in Cameo (or similar tool).

- Experience working with software-intensive systems and open architectures relevant to radar systems, such as COARPS and AMS-GRA

- Familiarity with programming languages (e.g. C, C++, Python).

Full-Time Salary Range: $138,000-190,000

postings.title: Senior Radar Systems Engineer
postings.description:
STR is focused on delivering National Defense capabilities by driving mission-focused strategies to develop advanced technology systems enabling enduring products and solutions focused on achieving the customer vision. Our programs deliver sustainable, reliable, and cost-efficient capabilities focused on end-customer needs that function in operationally relevant environments and timeframes. We consider the entire lifecycle of the solution, from conceptualization and architecting, through development to deployment, while leveraging novel technologies to deliver first-of-a-kind systems.

The Systems Development Division (SDD) within STR delivers technology advantage into users’ hands. We are seeking a Senior Radar Systems Engineer to support Systems Engineering activities related to radar systems development: working with customers to understand and decompose their requirements, defining expected external system interactions and integration requirements, deriving and allocating system requirements to software and hardware components, and to work closely with development teams to capture and maintain system design artifacts. You will work as part of a multi-disciplinary team of engineers to ensure that the Systems Engineering process is followed and properly captured to support required program design deliverables and review gates. As part of complete radar system development, you will work closely with software and hardware teams to capture system architectures of different radar modes and EW applications. You will be responsible for maintaining key systems engineering metrics to support program execution and communication with customers and management. You will leverage your experience capturing complex system designs in digital representations such as SysML using modeling tools like Cameo. 

As a Systems Engineer, you will also contribute to defining and executing analysis that will help assess radar performance. You will work with Chief Engineers, and development team leads to ensure that requirements are verified according to program expectations and are appropriately reflected in test plans and verification artifacts. You will have the opportunity to work across the full Systems Engineering lifecycle, working with hardware and software teams to learn and help test the functionality of subsystems such as the active electronically scanned antenna (AESA), digital receiver/exciter (DREX), inertial navigation system (INS), as well as the processor, power, and cooling subsystems.

Strong interpersonal, communication, and technical skills are required. Applicants are expected to be self-motivated, detail oriented and have a demonstrated ability to effectively communicate with all levels of management and individual contributors on the program team through strong written and verbal communication skills. You will be joining a dynamic team working across multiple disciplines with opportunities to further expand your knowledge and grow your career.

What you will do:

- Support the execution of a complete Systems Engineering process for radar system development programs

- Support program Chief Engineers and Systems Engineering leads in the decomposition of complex customer needs through derivation and allocation to subsystems and components.

- Effectively use tools to create, evaluate, and document system architectures and clearly communicate the solution to the team, STR management, and customers, which may include generating system models in Cameo.

- Support the evaluation system performance leveraging modeling and simulation.

- Participate in field testing to validate and optimize radar performance.

- Ensure appropriate level of rigor is applied to achieve systems that meet customer needs.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define system requirements, specifications and architectures for radars, and ensure seamless integration and interoperability of the system.

Who you are:

- This position requires an Active Secret security clearance, and ability to obtain a Top Secret (TS) clearance with eligibility to support special access programs (SAP), for which U.S. citizenship is needed by U.S. Government.

- Experience with entire radar systems and their principles of design, development, requirements verification, test planning, test execution, data analysis, and operations support.

- Experience in mapping from high-level mission needs to radar and EW system specifications related to parameters such as sensitivity, linearity, phase noise, inertial navigation system errors, instantaneous bandwidth, system latency, etc.

- Experience with capturing radar mode designs such as SAR, GMTI, AMTI and associated transmit and receive waveforms and signal processing chains.

- Experience with simulation tools and MATLAB.

- Experience in preparing and delivering briefings to customers and senior management.

- Familiarity with the execution of technical reviews (SRRs, PDRs, CDRs, TIMs).

- Background should include a Bachelor’s degree and at least 3 years of applicable experience directly related to development and deployment of radar systems; Master’s degree and at least 1 years of applicable experience; or PhD. Equivalent experience will be considered.

Even Better:

- Experience working with SysML models in Cameo (or similar tool).

- Experience working with software-intensive systems and open architectures relevant to radar systems, such as COARPS and AMS-GRA

- Familiarity with programming languages (e.g. C, C++, Python).

Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $138,000-190,000

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

postings.title: Senior Reverse Engineer
postings.description:
STR is hiring a Senior Reverse Engineer who has a passion for research and analysis of vulnerabilities in cyber physical systems. Work must be performed onsite. 

What you’ll do: 

- Reverse engineering complex software or firmware targets, ranging from typical Windows/Linux binaries to embedded firmware running non-traditional computer architectures and operating systems

- Developing and applying automated reverse engineering and binary analysis tools to characterize protocols, interfaces, and functionality of target systems

- Working in multi-discipline teams to develop innovative offensive cyber solutions to challenging problems from a wide variety of technologies 

- Performing vulnerability weaponization, exploit development, payload development, and exploit mitigation on a variety of challenging targets 

- Documenting, demonstrating, and presenting research 

- Solving real world problems that have an impact on national security

Who you are: 

- This position requires the ability to obtain an Active Top Secret (TS) security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is needed by the U.S. Government 

- Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity or related field plus a minimum of 5 years relevant experience 
(MS or PhD with equivalent work experience may also be considered) 

- Experience with binary analysis of software/firmware 

- Experience with disassembly tools, such as IDA Pro, Binary Ninja, or Ghidra 

- Proficiency in one or more programming languages: C/C++, Python, etc. 

- Proficiency in one or more Assembly Languages: x86, ARM, etc. 

- General understanding of reverse engineering fundamentals: memory layout, calling conventions, etc. 

Nice to haves: 

- Vulnerability research and analysis

- Knowledge of weaponizing discovered vulnerabilities into exploits 

- Implant or software patch development 

- Familiarity with binary emulation or vulnerability research, including tools such as QEMU or AFL++ 

- Experience with DSP architectures, such as Texas Instruments, STMicroelectronics, NXP, or Analog Devices. 

- Knowledge of operating system internals including memory/process/thread management 

- Embedded systems or firmware analysis 

- Experience development custom emulation tools to enable dynamic analysis 

- Disassembler/decompiler module development 

- Experience analyzing and reconstructing code/data flow 

- Automated reverse engineering or software analysis tool development 

- Experience debugging software without source code 

- Knowledge of binary file structures and formats 

- Experience analyzing protocols or message structures 

- Knowledge of anti-reverse engineering techniques 

- Knowledge of intrusion detection and anti-malware systems and techniques

Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $134,000 - $184,000

postings.title: Senior RF Engineer
postings.description:
About the Team: 

The STR Sensors Division specializes in the development of advanced sensor systems, with a particular focus on airborne and surface-based radar, space-based sensing, electronic warfare, and underwater acoustics. This position is within the Space Missions and Sensing (SMS) Sector of the Sensors Division. In this sector, we develop and deliver technology to advance space-based sensing, space control, and counter-sensing missions. 

The Role: 

The SMS Sector is seeking a RF Engineer to support design, development, integration and test activities in a Research & Development environment. In this role, you will be an integral part of a team developing counter sensing systems for radar, electronic warfare and other applications. This position offers significant opportunities for career growth within a fast-paced and rapidly expanding company. 

What you will do: 

- Work with small, multi-disciplinary teams to architect, design, implement, and test RF hardware systems enabling novel sensing, electronic warfare, and signal processing systems. The systems are predominantly fielded as deployable prototypes with the objective of transitioning to low-volume product systems

- Collaborate with the team to quantify goals, system performance objectives, requirements, metrics, dependencies, and risks to guide your work

- Design, simulate and test RF hardware systems, with an emphasis on RF system integration, test, and verification

- Perform performance trade studies and analyses of proposed hardware architectures.  Conduct performance analysis through simulations and real-world testing to validate system performance.

- Build, perform bench-top unit test, integrate, calibrate, and demonstrate/document system performance

- Work with signal processing team on sensing system test concept and execution methods

- Plan and implement over-the-air system tests and demonstrations, evaluate hardware and system readiness, , develop and evaluate performance metrics, verify requirements, manage system configuration and data, and write operational procedures, and performance reports

- Review system effectiveness and identify opportunities to advance and/or mature subsystems and system capabilities

- Prepare documentation including design specifications, drawings, test plans, and reports

Who you are: 

- This position requires the ability to obtain a Top Secret (TS) security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is required by U.S. Government

- BS in Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical discipline

- 5+ years experience working with RF components and subsystems, including T/R modules, rotary joints, pedestal, filters, radiating structures, isolators, amplifiers, cables, ADC/DAC, etc

- Design experience in: RF systems, subsystems, and/or component analysis (frequency planning, link budget analysis, transceiver architectures, cascade analysis) 

- Experienced in RF component/subsystem/system test and measurement equipment and techniques (anechoic chambers, oscilloscopes, vector network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, signal generators) 

- Proficiency in MATLAB and/or Python and/or other higher-level languages 

- Strong Mathematical, troubleshooting, written, and verbal communication skills  

Even Better: 

- Experience integrating hardware and software, software development and or experience integrating FPGA’s

- Active Secret or TS/SCI Clearance

postings.title: Senior Signal Processing Researcher
postings.description:
About the Team:

The Sensors Division at STR focuses on technology development for advanced sensor systems to add national security capabilities, particularly in the areas of airborne/surface-based radar, electronic warfare, underwater acoustics, hyperspectral imaging, and EO/IR sensing. Within these areas, we perform work on emerging concepts & technologies, component & system development and prototyping, and experimental campaigns.

The Optical & Novel Sensing (ONS) Group within the Sensors Division pursues physics-driven research across multiple domains to provide warfighter and intelligence mission performance unachievable with traditional sensors. Our main customer focus is on Department of War and Intelligence Community research and development programs, with work spanning concept formulation through validation prototyping.

The Role:

As a Senior Algorithm & Signal Processing Researcher, you will develop and apply state-of-the-art algorithms and techniques for HF communications that include signal detection, channel equalization, and geolocation. You'll have opportunities to engage directly with our customers to communicate technical analyses for their most critical challenges. You'll work with a team of researchers in creating innovative system capability and collaborate with the engineering team to develop and demonstrate and optimize system capabilities.

A successful candidate will have demonstrated strong analysis skills and expertise in several of the following areas: adaptive signal processing, equalization, High Frequency (HF) radio propagation, ionospheric physics, machine learning, algorithm development, algorithm integration, test & evaluation, model & simulation, systems engineering, or communications systems. They will apply first principles of physics to model and simulate realistic environments to support system performance modeling at HF radio frequencies to develop realistic simulations of complex propagation environments. This position requires skills contributing to a multi-disciplinary team designing, analyzing, integrating, and demonstrating signal processing algorithms for complex systems.

What you will Do: 

- Work closely with program leadership to spearhead efforts that align with program and company priorities

- Apply cutting-edge signal processing techniques to solve complex HF propagation challenges for critical national security missions

- Collaborate with diverse teams, learning from the different perspectives to develop and deploy prototype systems that demonstrate our ability to extend the boundaries of what's possible

- Document and present products to a community of scientists and subject matter experts

Who You Are: 

- Ability to obtain a Top Secret security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is needed by U.S. Government. 

- PhD, MS, or BS in Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or related technical discipline

- 3+ years of experience on RF programs, including the development of advanced signal- and data-processing algorithms from mathematical/analytical derivation through testing and verification of system performance

- Experience in two or more of the following areas: RF signal processing, HF propagation (or propagation in dispersive, heterogeneous media), adaptive signal processing, algorithm development, system model & simulation, and geolocation

- Excellent communicator with ability to develop and tailor technical briefs to influence a range of technical and non-technical audiences

- Proficiency in one or more scientific or mathematical programming languages, such as MATLAB, Python, and C/C++

- Strong mathematical, troubleshooting, written, and verbal communication skills

Even Better: 

- Active Top Secret Clearance

- Demonstrated ownership of complex research, development, and engineering efforts 

- Advanced degree in Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical discipline 

- Experience with HF propagation modes and an understanding of the underlying physics, end-to-end signal processing chain

- Ability to apply novel, innovative and interdisciplinary approaches to challenging engineering problems

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer
postings.description:
Sophisticated integrated systems play a critical role in national security efforts, facilitating an understanding of the global situation, strategic planning, and tactical execution. The reliability, accessibility, and sophistication of these systems can determine the outcomes of conflicts before they begin. STR’s Systems Development Division (SDD) focuses on developing advanced technology solutions to provide asymmetric advantages within the information domain. SDD executes the entire lifecycle of the solution, from conceptualization and architecture refinement through implementation and deployment, while leveraging novel technologies to deliver first-of-a-kind systems. Current efforts include programs for airborne and space RF sensors and advanced operations enabled by multi-function, multi-modal capabilities.

As a Senior Software Engineer in SDD, you will design, develop, and test C++ software implementing complex embedded radar systems, with a primary focus on Air-to-Air applications. 

What you will do:

- Translate system and software requirements into software designs compliant with architectural constraints and open architecture requirements

- Implement robust, high-quality C++ software suitable for mission-critical, real-time systems with high reliability and availability requirements

- Develop test frameworks to verify correct implementation and performance of C++ software

- Utilize and help iteratively improve DevSecOps development practices

- Participate in peer reviews of requirements, architecture, software implementations, and test plans

- Document software designs and interfaces

- Develop analysis tools

- Perform root cause analysis of software defects and implement corrections

Who You Are:

- This position requires the ability to obtain a Top Secret Security clearance, for which U.S citizenship is needed by U.S. Government

- BS in Computer Science or related technical field with at least 5 years of relevant experience

- Demonstrate expertise in C++14 and software engineering techniques including multi-threading, memory management, and performance optimization

- Have experience integrating with larger software systems, including unit and system-level testing

- Understand the use of GitLab, CI/CD tools, automated testing frameworks, and code quality tools in software development processes

- Feel comfortable adopting to new programing languages, third-party software frameworks, and innovative technologies

Even Better:

- Active security clearance

- Demonstrate familiarity with signal processing or mathematical modeling

- Have experience with GPU software development

- Have experience with RDMA

- Have experience with C++17 and beyond

- Demonstrate familiarity with radar concepts

- Demonstrate familiarity with integrated systems combining software and hardware to interact with the physical world

- Have experience in developing, optimizing, and translating MATLAB algorithms into efficient C++ code

- Hold an advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field

- Understand automation frameworks and tools used to streamline repetitive tasks and manage complex workflows

- Have domain expertise in one or more of the following areas: electronic warfare, antenna apertures, sensor resource management, large-scale platform test systems, cyber physical systems, open system architectures

postings.description:
About the Team:

The Real-time Architectures, Integration, and Demonstration (RAID) Group focuses on transition of algorithms from concept to real-time software, providing open architecture expertise, and facilitating integration of capabilities for experimentation, test, and deployment.

The Role:

As a Senior Software Engineer for Integration and Test you will focus on supporting the development, integration, and validation of real-time RF sensor software systems. You will work as part of a multi-disciplinary team to implement software components, integrate algorithms into open architecture frameworks, and develop test infrastructure to validate system performance. This role emphasizes hands-on software development, open system integration, integrating software components across distributed architectures and with hardware platforms, and rigorous testing of real-time applications.

What you will do:

- Implement software components for real-time sensor systems in C/C++

- Integrate signal processing algorithms into open architecture software frameworks

- Develop and execute integration tests and system-level validation tests

- Debug software issues in real-time, multi-threaded, and distributed systems

- Work with senior engineers to translate algorithm specifications into software implementations

- Develop test scripts and automated testing infrastructure

- Perform hands-on lab work with signal processing hardware and test equipment

- Document software designs, test procedures, results, and technical reports

- Support system demonstrations and field testing activities

- Participate in code reviews and contribute to software quality improvements

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including algorithm developers, systems engineers, and integration staff

- Support approximately 20% travel for integration events, field testing, and customer demonstrations

Who you are:

- Active clearance at the Secret level with ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is a government requirement

- BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field with relevant experience depending on degree (BS +5 years, MS +3 years, PhD +1 year)

- Experienced in software development (internships and academic projects count)

- Strong proficiency in C/C++ programming

- Experience with version control systems (Git)

- Experience with Linux

- Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills

- Strong willingness to learn signal processing and real-time embedded systems

Even Better:

- Active Top Secret clearance (TS/SCI preferred)

- Effective written and verbal communication skills

- Proficiency in Python or MATLAB

- Experience with hands-on hardware testing and lab equipment

- Coursework or experience in signal processing

- Experience with real-time or embedded software development

- Knowledge of multithreaded programming and synchronization

- Understanding of open architecture principles and standards

postings.title: Simulation Based Systems Test Engineer
postings.description:
About the Team

The Sensors Division develops advanced solutions in radar, space-based sensing, electronic warfare, and underwater acoustics. Within the Space Missions and Sensing (SMS) Sector, we focus on advancing space sensing, space control, and counter-sensing technologies for critical national security missions.

The Role: 

In this position, you will design, implement, and operate integrated simulation testbeds for advanced space and defense systems. Your work will include analyzing integrated system performance, developing and executing test plans, and defining system evaluation criteria. postings.title: Software Developer - Business Applications & Analytics
postings.description:
STR is seeking a motivated and versatile Software Developer to join our Strategic Projects, Analytics & Applications (SPAA) team within the Operations Division. SPAA is responsible for developing and sustaining enterprise business capabilities through cross-functional project execution, business analytics, and business applications management.

This position will support the design, development, integration, and maintenance of software tools and applications that improve business processes, automate workflows, and enable data-driven decision-making across STR.

Working closely with the Business Analytics and Business Applications functional leads, the Software Developer will develop and maintain solutions that support enterprise reporting, data integration, business system administration, and operational efficiency. The ideal candidate will be a technically capable, creative problem-solver who enjoys collaborating with business stakeholders to translate operational needs into reliable, scalable software solutions.

Description & Responsibilities / What you will do:

- Collaborate with Business Analytics, Business Applications, and other stakeholders to gather requirements, identify opportunities for automation and process improvement, and translate business needs into technical solutions.

- Develop product roadmaps, prioritize and maintain feature backlogs, and communicate progress to project stakeholders.

- Design, develop, and test software applications, tools, integrations, APIs, and automated workflows that support enterprise business operations, including STR's enterprise data warehouse and associated data processing capabilities.

- Leverage AI-assisted development tools and coding agents to accelerate software development, testing, and maintenance.

- Deploy and maintain containerized applications (e.g., Docker, Podman) using CI/CD pipelines, source control, and automated testing to ensure reliable software delivery.

- Collaborate with IT and cybersecurity teams to ensure solutions meet STR's technical, infrastructure, and security requirements.

- Troubleshoot, maintain, and enhance existing applications, scripts, integrations, and automation tools, providing ongoing operational support and technical documentation.

- Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to software development practices, system reliability, and enterprise capabilities.

- Minimum of 2 years of professional software development experience

- Proficiency in Python and experience with one or more additional programming languages, such as C++ or Java

- Experience using AI-assisted software development tools and coding agents, such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar technologies

- Experience developing, testing, and maintaining software solutions intended for reliable enterprise use

- Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Docker and Podman

- Experience with Git-based source control, CI/CD tools such as GitLab, and automated build and deployment pipelines

- Working knowledge of Linux environments and basic system administration

- Understanding of IT cybersecurity fundamentals and secure software development practices

- Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to independently investigate and resolve technical challenges

- Organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple development and support priorities

- Demonstrated communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Nice to have:

- Experience with SQL, relational databases, data engineering, ETL/ELT pipelines, or data warehouse technologies

- Experience with infrastructure automation, application monitoring, logging, and operational support

- Familiarity with software development practices in regulated or security-conscious environments

STR is hiring a Software Engineer to join our multidisciplinary cyber/networking team committed to developing cutting-edge technologies that have an immediate and significant impact on our national security. Our team innovates communications technology across all networking layers, from the physical to the application layer. We value diverse skills, experiences, and perspectives, which are vital to delivering innovative solutions to our customers. If any of the skills below align with your expertise, we encourage you to apply!

Job Overview: A successful candidate will possess experience in software engineering, integration and testing, and networking concepts and protocols, with a strong passion for results-driven development on Linux systems. This candidate will bring a versatile skill set in computer science, software architecture, and practical software development, testing, and documentation. The ideal Software Engineer is intellectually curious, motivated, and thrives in a team-based environment focused on rapid prototyping and delivering impactful solutions.

This is an exciting opportunity to work in a high-profile, fast-paced, yet structured development environment alongside a diverse and talented team. In this role, you will design, implement, and test software that enhances advanced real-time data communications and networking solutions using open systems principles. We aim for the highest standards of quality, maintainability, and reuse in our tools and techniques. Therefore, experience with sound software engineering principles and testing methodologies is crucial.

What you will do:

- Collaborate closely with a small, dedicated research team to develop innovative solutions to complex problems

- Execute assigned tasks and report overall status to project leadership

- Develop and test novel software solutions spanning research, development, and deployed production systems

- Identify creative and innovative approaches to open-ended problems

- Deliver high-quality software in a rapid-paced team environment

- Develop operational prototypes for experimentation and performance analysis

- Create customer-facing operational systems

- Familiar with rapid prototyping design methodologies and open architectures

- Someone with a working knowledge of software testing and evaluation best practices

- Experience developing software with GNU/Linux toolchains using open-source software

- Understanding of the 5-layer OSI networking stack

- Have a Bachelor's or Masters degree in Computer Science, Electrical & Computer Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field, with at least 2 years of relevant experience

postings.title: Software Reverse Engineer
postings.description:
STR is hiring a Software Reverse Engineer who has a passion for research and analysis of vulnerabilities in cyber physical systems. Work must be performed onsite.

What you’ll do:

- Reverse engineering complex software or firmware targets, ranging from typical Windows/Linux binaries to embedded firmware running non-traditional computer architectures and operating systems

- Developing and applying automated reverse engineering and binary analysis tools to characterize protocols, interfaces, and functionality of target systems

- Developing innovative cybersecurity solutions

- Working in multi-discipline teams to tackle challenging problems from a wide variety of technologies to develop innovative cybersecurity solutions

- Performing vulnerability weaponization, exploit development, payload development, and exploit mitigation on a variety of challenging targets

- Documenting, demonstrating, and presenting research

- Solving real world problems that have an impact on national security

Who you are:

- This position requires an Active Top Secret (TS) security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is needed by the U.S. Government

- BS, MS or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity or related field (or equivalent work experience)

- Experience with binary analysis of software/firmware

- Experience with disassembly tools, such as IDA Pro, Binary Ninja, or Ghidra

- Proficiency in one or more programming languages: C/C++, Python, etc.

- Proficiency in one or more Assembly Languages: x86, ARM, etc.

- General understanding of reverse engineering fundamentals: memory layout, calling conventions, etc.

Nice to haves:

- Vulnerability research and analysis

- Knowledge of weaponizing discovered vulnerabilities into exploits

- Implant or software patch development

- Familiarity with binary emulation or vulnerability research, including tools such as QEMU or AFL++

- Experience with DSP architectures, such as Texas Instruments, STMicroelectronics, NXP, or Analog Devices.

- Knowledge of operating system internals including memory/process/thread management

- Embedded systems or firmware analysis

- Experience development custom emulation tools to enable dynamic analysis

- Disassembler/decompiler module development

- Experience analyzing and reconstructing code/data flow

- Automated reverse engineering or software analysis tool development

- Experience debugging software without source code

- Knowledge of binary file structures and formats

- Experience analyzing protocols or message structures

- Knowledge of anti-reverse engineering techniques

- Knowledge of intrusion detection and anti-malware systems and techniques

postings.title: Systems Software Integration and Test Engineer
postings.description:
STR is focused on delivering National Defense capabilities by driving mission-focused strategies to develop advanced technology systems enabling products and solutions focused on achieving the customer vision. Our programs deliver sustainable, reliable, and cost-efficient capabilities focused on end-customer needs that function in operationally relevant environments and timeframes. We consider the entire lifecycle of the solution, from conceptualization and architecting, through development to deployment, while leveraging novel technologies to deliver first-of-a-kind systems. 

We are seeking a Systems Software Integration & Test (I&T) Engineer in our Woburn, MA office to support integration and test of advanced multi-function RF systems. The I&T Engineer should have experience performing subsystem and system level integration and test of software and/or hardware components to include building test sets and test software to verify system interfaces and functionality implementation against requirements. The I&T Engineer should have familiarity with automated test tools and techniques, writing and executing test plans and procedures, and contributing to system design packages. 

This position offers the opportunity to work with leading domain experts in sensors development, data analytics, and cyber security. The I&T Engineer will be expected to work closely with development teams to execute system testing both in a SIL environment as well as field tests. Experience with the Agile development process and associated tools is desired. This position is well suited for an engineer who has experience building DoD systems and is interested in hands on testing and fielding of novel systems developed by STR. Both hardware and software-centric candidates are encouraged to apply to meet comprehensive system testing needs. 

What you will do: 

- Working closely with domain experts, development teams, and systems engineers to design and develop test software 

- Develop software scripts and procedures to verify performance of complex multi-function RF processing algorithms 

- Capturing and communicating test results and metrics internally with development teams 

- Assist in preparing and delivering briefings, familiarity with the execution of technical reviews (SRRs, PDRs, CDRs, TIMS, TRRs) 

- Perform subsystem and system level integration test of firmware, software and/or hardware components and assemblies 

Who you are: 

- This position requires the ability to obtain a DoD Top Secret Clearance  for which U.S. citizenship is needed by the U.S. Government 

- BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related technical field with a minimum 2 years of relevant experience 

- Become an integral part of a Systems / Software team on RF related programs supporting system/mission level integration and testing. 

- Familiarity with containerized software 

- Proficient in at least one of the following: MATLAB, Python, C++ 

- Experience developing in Linux environments (Ubuntu and RHEL) 

- Perform data analysis post processing test data using MATLAB, Python or other software tools 

- Familiarity with Agile Systems Engineering using Jira, Confluence, BitBucket, Gitlab 

- Travel required to support off site test activities 

Nice to Have: 

- Active Secret or Top Secret Security Clearance 

- Experience and familiarity with RF sensor systems integration. 

- Domain expertise in one or more of the following areas is desirable; Radar, Electronic Warfare, , Antenna Apertures, Sensor Resource Management, Sea/Air/Space, Large-Scale Platform Test Systems, Cyber Physical Systems, Open System Architectures (UCI, OMS, COARPS) 

- Proficiency in automated test tools and techniques 

- Proficiency in bash scripting 

- Familiarity with MBSE tools such as Cameo (MagicDraw), Sparx Enterprise Architect, IBM Rational Rhapsody 

- Familiarity with developing software for predefined pub/sub messaging architecture, specific government open architectures (e.g., Open Mission Systems)

postings.title: University Relations Recruiter - Temporary
postings.description:
STR is seeking a collaborative and relationship driven University Relations Recruiter to lead university recruiting initiatives and manage STR's internship program. This role is hybrid based out of Woburn, MA and the individual will partner closely with divisional leadership and hiring leaders to develop targeted recruiting strategies, establish university partnerships, and build a strong pipeline of emerging technical talent. The role is responsible for managing the full recruitment lifecycle for internship and entry-level opportunities while delivering a consistent and engaging internship experience across STR.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute STR's university relations and recruiting strategy, aligning campus engagement and talent pipeline initiatives with divisional hiring needs and long-term workforce priorities.

- Identify and prioritize target universities and academic programs based on technical talent needs, research areas, and strategic recruiting opportunities.

- Build and maintain relationships with university career services, faculty, professors, academic departments, and student organizations to strengthen STR's campus presence and attract qualified candidates.

- Partner with divisional leadership and hiring managers to understand talent requirements, develop recruiting plans, and support internship and entry-level hiring objectives.

- Manage the full-cycle recruitment process for internship and entry-level positions, including sourcing, screening, interview coordination, candidate selection, and offer management.

- Plan and execute university recruiting activities, including career fairs, information sessions, networking opportunities, and other campus engagement events.

- Oversee STR's internship program, coordinating program planning, onboarding, intern engagement activities, performance feedback, and program evaluations in partnership with divisional stakeholders.

- Identify opportunities to enhance the internship experience and support the conversion of high-performing interns into full-time employees.

- Track recruiting activity, university partnership effectiveness, and internship program outcomes to measure success and drive continuous improvement.

- Serve as a brand ambassador for STR, promoting our mission, culture, and career opportunities while fostering strong relationships with candidates and hiring leaders.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience.

- 5+ years of experience in university recruiting, early-career talent acquisition, or related recruiting initiatives including internship programs.

- Demonstrated experience developing and executing university recruiting strategies, including identifying target institutions, building talent pipelines, and establishing strategic campus partnerships

- Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple business divisions.

- Strong ability to manage full-cycle recruiting processes and coordinate multiple initiatives simultaneously.

- Excellent organizational, project management, and communication skills.

- Proficiency with applicant tracking systems and Microsoft Office applications.

- Willingness to travel to university campuses, recruiting events, and STR locations as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience recruiting technical and engineering talent in the defense industry.

- Familiarity with recruiting metrics, talent pipeline development, and program evaluation.
